title: Textured Woven Upholstery Fabric
facts: This is a woven fabric with a textured appearance, composed wholly of polyester. It uses both multifilament textured polyester yarns and fancy yarns of textured polyester filament, with yarns of different colors. The fabric has 24 warp ends and 15 filling picks per centimeter and weighs 532.5 grams per square meter. It is supplied in a width of 145 centimeters and is intended for use in upholstery applications.

title: Women’s Knit Sweater
facts: This is a women’s knit sweater made from a single eight-ply yarn that combines cotton, polyester, nylon, elastane, and metallic fibers. The overall fiber composition is 47.7 percent cotton, 31.3 percent polyester, 13.7 percent nylon, 6.6 percent elastane, and 0.7 percent metallic. The sweater features a crew neckline, long ribbed cuffs, decorative sequins, and a ribbed bottom, and it extends below the waist. The fabric surface measures less than 9 stitches per 2 centimeters in the direction the stitches were formed. The sweater is packaged as a single garment ready for retail sale.

title: Women’s Sleeveless Knit Sweater
facts: This is a sleeveless women’s knit sweater made from a blend of 58.91 percent polyester, 28.32 percent cotton, 8.54 percent nylon, 2.21 percent metallic, and 2.02 percent rayon/flax. The sweater features a rib knit crew neckline, oversized armholes, and a fancy rib knit bottom band. It is constructed from one six-ply yarn composed of four one-ply yarns and one two-ply yarn, where the two-ply yarns are twisted together and then combined with the one-ply yarns. The outer surface of the fabric measures less than nine stitches per two centimeters in the direction the stitches were formed. The garment is imported in its final retail form, ready to wear without further processing.

title: Men’s Sleeveless Jacket
facts: This is a men’s sleeveless jacket made from a bonded fabric with three layers: an outer layer of 100% polyester woven fabric, a middle layer of polyurethane film, and an inner layer of 100% polyester knit fabric identified as weft knit pile. The jacket features oversized armholes, a stand-up collar, a full front opening closed with a zipper, zippered pockets below the waist, and an elastic drawcord with locks passing through a casing at the hemmed bottom.

title: Women’s Knit Sweater
facts: This is a women’s knit sweater with a V-neckline, long raglan sleeves, and a straight hemmed bottom that extends from the shoulders to below the waist. The fabric is composed of 44 percent polyamide, 21 percent alpaca hair, 21 percent wool, and 14 percent metallic yarn. The outer surface of the fabric measures less than nine stitches per two centimeters in the direction the stitches were formed. The sweater is constructed from two types of yarn twisted together: Yarn 1, which is 71.6 percent of the fabric weight and consists of a one-ply nylon/animal fiber yarn, and Yarn 2, which is 28.4 percent of the fabric weight and is composed of two three-ply nylon monofilament yarns and one metalized yarn. The metalized yarn in Yarn 2 consists of a one-ply nylon filament yarn twisted with a one-ply metallic yarn.

title: Let’s String Kit
facts: The Let’s String Kit is an arts and crafts assembly kit packaged for individual retail sale. It includes a wooden base measuring 19.5 × 19.5 × 0.375 inches, pre-fitted with 240 metal nails arranged in a precise circle. The kit contains a spool of nylon filament yarn weighing approximately 150 grams, a wooden spool bracket that attaches to the main base, an adjustable smartphone support stand, a structural cardboard retail container that deploys as a working artist's easel, a step-by-step instruction manual, and access to online software that processes uploaded photos to create interactive, voiced, step-by-step guides. The yarn is a single, continuous nylon monofilament that is untwisted, untextured, and not elastomeric. The kit is intended for users aged 14 years and older.

title: Hexaphenoxycyclotriphosphazene
facts: The product is Hexaphenoxycyclotriphosphazene, also known as 2,2,4,4,6,6-hexaphenoxy-1,3,5-triaza-2λ5,4λ5,6λ5-triphosphacyclohexa-1,3,5-triene, with CAS Number 1184-10-7. It is supplied in bulk powder form. The compound functions as a fire-retardant additive and is intended for use in materials requiring enhanced flame resistance. It is composed of phosphorus, nitrogen, carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen atoms arranged in a cyclic molecular structure. The product is manufactured through chemical synthesis processes and is provided in industrial packaging suitable for bulk handling and storage.

title: Nero Mist Stone
facts: The Nero Mist stone is a naturally occurring dark gray stone with lighter gray patches and white specks across its surface. It measures approximately 120 inches in length by 76 inches in width and is available in thicknesses of either 2 or 3 centimeters. The stone is surface-worked to prepare it for use. It is intended for applications such as kitchen islands and countertops, providing a durable and decorative surface for these areas.

title: Hexachloroacetone
facts: The product is hexachloroacetone, identified by CAS Number 116-16-5, supplied from Germany in bulk form. It is available in two purity grades: standard grade with a minimum purity of 99.2 percent and high grade with a minimum purity of 99.8 percent. The substance is an acyclic, halogenated ketone derivative. Its primary application is in the production of sevoflurane. Additional uses include pharmaceutical, agricultural, and various industrial chemical applications.

title: Desert Atlas stone
facts: The product is a natural stone material known as Desert Atlas, sourced from Brazil. It displays an ivory-colored base with distinctive patches of olive, dark green, and amber, along with dark green veining and streaks. The stone measures approximately 6 square meters in top surface area and has a uniform thickness of 3 centimeters. The top surface is honed, while the sides are cut or sawn. After importation, the stone will be further cut to size and shape for use in applications such as countertops and tabletops. Laboratory analysis confirms the material is an igneous stone with minimal quartz content.

title: White Delicatus Stone
facts: The product is a natural stone material known as White Delicatus, originating from Brazil. It displays a white, cream, and light gray base color with black streaks and dark reddish-brown flecks. The stone is an igneous rock composed of quartz and albite. Each piece measures approximately 2 meters in length by 3 meters in height, with a thickness of either 2 or 3 centimeters. The top and side surfaces are polished, and the edges are beveled. After importation, the stone will be cut to size and shape for use in both indoor and outdoor applications, including countertops, wall cladding, surfaces, and flooring.

title: Thyroid USP Powder
facts: The product is Thyroid USP Powder provided in bulk form. It consists of desiccated porcine thyroid as the active ingredient combined with anhydrous dextrose. The powder is supplied in its unmixed state, intended for further formulation into a final medicinal product. The finished drug will be used for treating hypothyroidism. The powder is sourced from New Zealand and delivered in bulk packaging suitable for pharmaceutical processing.

title: LAN Cable
facts: The article is a Local Area Network (LAN) Cable, model number UTP Cat6 PLUS 4-pair Solid LAN Cable. It is a communications cable used for Ethernet and related work applications for data transmission across various industries and installations. The cable is constructed from four twisted pairs of 23 AWG copper wire, each pair insulated with polyethylene, and the entire assembly is jacketed with Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC). The cable is rated for 300 volts and is supplied without any connectors attached. It is imported in packaging of 1,000 feet per box.

title: Areca Nuts
facts: The product is areca nuts, also known as betel nuts, harvested from areca palm trees. The nuts are sun-dried for a period of two months to achieve the desired moisture content. After drying, the nuts are de-husked to remove the outer shell, leaving the kernel. The kernels are then graded based on size and weight requirements to ensure uniform quality. Each package contains eight betel nuts and has a net weight of 500 grams. The product is intended for retail sale in grocery stores without any additional processing or packaging beyond the basic grading and weighing.

title: NUTRACOR 80P
facts: NUTRACOR 80P is a palm fatty acid distillate presented in the form of light brown micro-prills, each measuring approximately 300–500 microns in size. The product is composed of long chain fatty acids with a minimum crude fat content of 99%, a maximum moisture content of 1%, and a minimum free fatty acid content of 90%. It contains palmitic acid in a concentration ranging from 80% to 85%. The material is derived from freshly produced palm fatty acid distillates that naturally include phytonutrients. It is intended for use as a rumen bypass fat in livestock feed.

title: Saturnia Stone
facts: The product is a natural stone material known as Saturnia, sourced from Brazil. It appears in a charcoal gray to black base color with brown and white flecks distributed throughout. Each piece measures approximately 115 to 122 inches in length, 65 to 75 inches in width, and is available in two thicknesses: 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches. The top surface of the stone is polished for a smooth finish, while the sides are cut or sawn without additional finishing. After importation, the stone will be cut to specific sizes and shapes for use as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and office furniture tops.

title: Venlafaxine HCL Extended-Release Capsules
facts: The product consists of Venlafaxine HCL in extended-release capsule form, available in strengths of 37.5 mg, 75 mg, and 150 mg per capsule. Each capsule is designed to release the active ingredient gradually over time. The capsules are intended for oral administration by patients to help manage major depressive disorder, generalized anxiety disorder, social anxiety disorder, and panic disorder. The product is supplied in dosage form ready for pharmaceutical use.

title: Stainless-Steel Pipe Assemblies for Motor Vehicle Emissions Control
facts: These are stainless-steel pipe assemblies, identified by Katon Part Numbers 6008516, 6008517, 6008518, 6008519, 60036876, and 60036879, designed exclusively for integration into the GMT610 L8T Y-3x catalytic converter emissions aftertreatment system in motor vehicles. Each assembly is constructed from stainless steel for its high-temperature endurance and corrosion resistance in exhaust environments. The assemblies manage, balance, and direct exhaust gas flow into three catalytic converter units to purify emissions. KPN 6008516 and KPN 6008517 each include a flange, sensor boss, pipe, and bracket assembly (nut and bracket). KPN 6008518 and KPN 60036876 each contain a pipe and sensor boss. KPN 6008519 and KPN 60036879 each consist of two pipes, a sensor boss, and two stamped pieces. The assemblies distribute exhaust gases in precise volumes, maintain required pressure drops for system performance, and support catalytic reaction efficiency.

title: Kibbled Carob Cubes
facts: The product is 100 percent pure carob cubes intended for use as animal feed. The cubes may be used directly or mixed with other prime materials to feed rabbits, hamsters, and chinchillas. The carob cubes have undergone minor mechanical processing to reduce particle size and consist of a single agricultural ingredient without added vitamins, minerals, binders, flavoring agents, or other substances. The merchandise is shipped in 20-kilogram bags for sale to animal feed companies in the United States.

title: Turbocharger Components
facts: These items are functional parts of a turbocharger used to manage and enhance air pressure from a ship's engine, operating above 35 pounds per square inch. Item 79000 is a ring-shaped diffuser made of iron with vanes and a central bore that expands air pressure. Item 21000 is an iron turbine shaft with threads and a bladed wheel that rotates to move air pressure to a compressor. Item 25000 is a compressor wheel made of aluminum with blades and a splined hub. Item 42001 is an iron casing that partially encloses and protects the shaft connecting the turbine to the compressor wheel. Item 51000 is an iron gas inlet casing shaped like a volute to direct air to the turbine shaft. Item 56001 is an iron nozzle ring with blades or ridges that matches the circular section of the turbocharger’s gas inlet.

title: Locking Carabiners
facts: These are locking carabiners designed and marketed for mountaineering and recreational climbing. They feature a gate that requires deliberate user action to lock and unlock, preventing accidental opening. The “Screwgate” model has a manual screw-locking gate mechanism, while the “Kwiklock” and “Locksafe” models have a manual locking gate. All models consist primarily of aluminum with some plastic components and contain no electronic parts or motors. They are available in various sizes, weights, strength ratings, and colors, and are intended for use by individuals working at height as well as for climbing activities.

title: Ceros Locking Screw-Gate Carabiners
facts: These are locking screw-gate carabiners with an additional internal wire gate, designed and marketed for use as mechanical connectors in rock climbing, mountaineering, and recreational climbing. The carabiners are primarily used for belaying and feature a locking gate design that prevents accidental opening and gate flutter under load, enhancing the ease of clipping and unclipping ropes and slings. They require deliberate user action to lock and unlock the manual locking gate. The carabiners consist of metal and plastic components, with aluminum as the predominant material. They measure 74 mm in width by 121 mm in length and weigh 86, 92, or 93 grams, with a strength rating of 25 kilonewtons. The carabiners are imported in a variety of colors and are intended for use by individuals engaging in climbing activities and working at height.

title: Underworld Anubis Adult Costume
facts: The costume is an adult size ensemble identified as Underworld Anubis, item number 5126-058. It includes a long, sleeveless pullover top referred to as a tunic, a separate collar, wrist cuffs, a belt, a headpiece, and a mask. The tunic is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features raw, unfinished armholes, neck, and hem bottom. The garment is shapeless and stitched together with long, loose, straight stitching. All components are designed to be worn together as a coordinated costume for theatrical or themed events.

title: Engine Flange Sealants
facts: These are industrial sealing products made by Henkel under the Loctite brand, specifically the Loctite 5900 and Loctite 5910 Engine Flange Sealants. They are silicone-based, non-corrosive sealing compounds. The products form flexible, oil-resistant gaskets between metal surfaces in engines and industrial equipment. They are used in engine flange sealing and industrial machinery applications, primarily for industrial maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) operations. These sealants are intended for use in automotive engines, agricultural machinery, and other industrial equipment, and are not designed for consumer or household adhesive applications.

title: Steel Wheels for Off-Highway Dump Trucks
facts: These are steel wheels with a part number 143-2135, designed for use on off-highway dump trucks, specifically model CAT 777, which operate in mining and large construction environments. The wheels are constructed entirely from steel. Each wheel has a diameter between 25 cm and 63 cm. They are supplied as individual components intended for assembly onto the truck chassis and are not included in any finished assembly or package beyond their protective packaging for shipment and handling.

title: Belay Master Locking Screw-Gate Carabiner
facts: The item is a locking screw-gate carabiner designed as a mechanical connector for securing users or equipment. It is constructed primarily from aluminum with plastic components, including a plastic clip. The carabiner measures 74 millimeters in width and 121 millimeters in length, weighing 86 grams, and has a strength rating of 25 kilonewtons. It features a manual locking gate that requires deliberate user action to lock and unlock, with no motorized or electronic components. The carabiner is available in various colors and is intended for use in rock climbing, mountaineering, and recreational climbing, where it provides consistent rope control and compatibility with belay devices. It also has applications for individuals working at height.

title: DMM CAMS
facts: These are spring-loaded camming devices offered in three styles: Dragon Cams (ten sizes), Dragonfly Cams (six sizes), and Dragonfly Offset Cams (four sizes). Each size is marked by a specific color. They are made from high-strength aluminum alloys and feature spring-loaded cam lobes mounted on a rigid axle, which expand and contract to grip natural rock features under load. Each device includes a flexible stem, an ergonomic trigger assembly for controlled placement and removal, and a sewn textile sling for connection to the user’s climbing system. They function as passive protection hardware for mountaineering, rock climbing, and recreational climbing activities, designed to resist load and help arrest falls when integrated into a climbing system using a carabiner and rope.

title: Dr. Melaxin Bondex Hair Clinic Treatment
facts: This is a hair preparation formulated with protein and moisturizing ingredients to help strengthen and care for damaged hair. It is packaged for retail sale in an 8.45 fluid ounce (250ml) plastic container. The product is intended for personal care use, typically applied to hair to improve its condition. The container is designed for easy dispensing and storage. It is marketed toward consumers seeking hair repair and maintenance.

title: DDM Climbing Torque Nuts
facts: These are climbing hardware components offered in two styles: Climbing Torque Nuts and Climbing Wired Torque Nuts, each available in four sizes identified by color and item numbers A1741-A1744 and A1751-A1754 respectively. They are made of high-strength aluminum alloys with a shaped metal head designed to engage securely with rock constrictions. A flexible stainless-steel wire permanently connects the head to a sewn textile sling, forming an attachment point for climbing equipment. The items function as passive protection hardware for mountaineering and rock climbing, resisting load and helping arrest falls when integrated into a climbing system via a carabiner and rope. They perform in all weather conditions and are particularly useful in winter when icy cracks cannot be protected by cams. Wired torque nuts include an additional steel wire for increased resistance to accidental strikes and improved control when placed above the climber’s head. The designs feature tapered, offset, curved, or torque-specific profiles to enhance holding performance in irregular or flared cracks.

title: Dr. Melaxin Cemenrete Calcium Volume Eye Patch
facts: The product is a set of 60 hydrogel eye patches intended for application around the eyes and other facial areas. Each patch contains skin nourishing ingredients including calcium gluconate, hydrolyzed elastin, and collagen extract. The patches are designed for single use and are applied using an enclosed hygiene spoon provided with the product. After use, consumers are instructed to remove the patch after 20 to 30 minutes and pat the remaining essence onto the skin. The 60 patches are packaged for retail sale in a plastic container.

title: SPF Dimensional Lumber
facts: The product is SPF (spruce-pine-fir) dimensional lumber imported from Canada. The boards are planed, with edges that may be eased, and are supplied in the following dimensions: 2 inches by 3 inches by 7 feet, 2 inches by 3 inches by 9 feet, 2 inches by 3 inches by 10 feet, 2 inches by 4 inches by 7 feet, and 2 inches by 6 inches by 7 feet. The lumber is used in the manufacturing of mattress box springs. The boards are not radius-cut on the ends and are not provided in kits with specific finished parts for assembling a box spring. Additional processing, including radius cutting, will occur in the United States after the lumber is imported.

title: Petite Libellule Glass Car Mascot
facts: The article is a decorative glass mascot shaped like a dragonfly with folded wings. It measures approximately 13.5 centimeters long by 6.5 centimeters high and is made of molded glass. Originally designed in 1928 by artist Réne Lalique for use as an automobile radiator cap, it is now used as a decorative item for homes or offices. The mascot is sold individually and has a value exceeding $5.

title: CM1586QX Surface
facts: The CM1586QX is a polished, plain white surface measuring approximately 300 to 350 centimeters long by 140 to 200 centimeters wide, and between 1.2 to 3 centimeters thick. It is composed of 45 to 55 percent by weight aluminum hydroxide, 30 to 40 percent by weight recycled glass granules, and 8 to 15 percent by weight polyester resin, with the remainder being pigments and additives. The aluminum hydroxide used is a byproduct of industrial processes and is not naturally derived. After importation, the surface is cut to size and shape for use in applications such as countertops, shelving, and flooring.

title: Aviation Headset Cables
facts: These are three distinct cables designed for use with the Sierra aviation headset. The first cable, part number 300-00008-000.A1, features a length of insulated copper conductor terminated at one end with a 6-POS 'PICO' connector and at the other end with a contact connector. It is integrated into the headset's headband to connect the left and right earcups, transmitting both power and microphone signals. The second cable, part number 300-00009-000.A2, consists of a length of insulated copper wire terminated at one end with a 3-POS 'PICO' connector, with the opposite end left unterminated for internal wiring. This cable is placed within the headset's boom mic to link the microphone to the main electronics, handling audio and power signals. The third cable, part number 300-00011-000.B2, includes multiple individually insulated copper conductors wired to a 5-POS 'PICO' connector on one end, with the opposite end left unterminated. This cable connects to the left earcup assembly and relays signals from the printed circuit board to the speaker, including active noise cancelling, monitoring, and audio signals.

title: Aviation Headset Cables
facts: These are two cables specifically designed for use with the Zulu aviation headset. The first cable, part number 300-00047-000.A3, consists of a length of insulated conductor terminated at one end with a 9-POS connector and at the other end with a cylindrical breakaway connector. It connects the headset to the control box, transmitting power and audio signals for noise cancellation, audio processing, and power supply, enabling the pilot to hear air traffic control and use the aircraft's intercom system. The second cable, part number 300-00048-001.A1, also consists of a length of insulated conductor that splits into two at one end and is terminated with multi-pin connectors, while the other end is terminated with a cylindrical quick disconnect connector. This cable connects each earcup to the control box, transmitting power and audio signals to allow the pilot to hear air traffic control and use the aircraft's intercom system with active noise cancellation.

title: Seared Sous Vide Red Wine Braised Beef
facts: The product consists of portioned pieces of beef measuring approximately 2 inches by 2.5 inches by the natural thickness of the muscle. The beef is marinated with water, spices, red wine-type natural flavoring, starch, and beef stock to achieve a marinade pickup of about 25 percent of the meat’s original weight. The marinated beef pieces are seared in oil for approximately 30 seconds at 360° Fahrenheit. After searing, a dry rub composed of spices, dextrose, and caramel color is applied. The beef pieces are vacuum packed with onions and mushrooms in a mixture consisting of approximately 86 percent meat, yellow onions, and mushrooms. The sealed pouches are sous vide cooked for 10 hours at 180° Fahrenheit, then blast frozen. The final product is fully cooked and contains no red wine, only red wine-type natural flavoring.

title: Economy Equipment Stand for Countertop Cooking
facts: The Economy Equipment Stand for Countertop Cooking is a metal stand designed for use in restaurant kitchens to support griddles, char broilers, and other countertop cooking equipment units. The stand features a top made from 430 series stainless steel, an under shelf and legs constructed from 18-gauge galvanized steel, and adjustable plastic foot inserts on the legs. The stand measures 30 inches in depth, 60 inches in width, and 24 inches in height, and includes a 1-inch splashguard on three sides. The total weight of the stand is 79 pounds, and it has a weight capacity of 390 pounds.

title: Child Size Costume Set
facts: The costume set is a child size ensemble that includes a short-sleeved pullover dress, a shawl, and flower hair clips. The dress is made from flimsy man-made knitted and woven textiles. The neck and sleeve edges are folded over once and stitched with a single line of long, loose straight stitching. A strip of exposed elastic is sewn directly to the dress at the waist using a single line of long, loose straight stitching. The dress hem features large, visible, loose overlock stitching. The entire set is packaged for retail sale.

title: Owlette Infant Costume
facts: The costume is an infant size and includes a long-sleeved, footed jumpsuit and a character headpiece. The jumpsuit is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile. It features a deep back opening with raw, unfinished edges folded over once and stitched with long, loose straight stitching, closed with two small tabs of hook and loop fastener. The long sleeves are designed to depict wings and have hand openings with raw edges folded over once and stitched similarly. The open inseam on the legs has a raw, unfinished edge on one side and is closed with seven very small tabs of hook and loop fasteners. Foam feet are permanently attached to the legs.

title: Spartan Queen Adult Costume
facts: The product is an adult size costume identified as Spartan Queen, item number 01068, consisting of a halter-style dress and an arm band. The dress is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile. It features raw, unfinished edges on the back neck ties and back ties, with some gathering on the bodice but is not well-made. The dress includes two front drapes with raw, unfinished edges that create two waist-high slits, and the hem is also raw and unfinished.

title: Occult Priestess Adult Costume
facts: The costume is an adult-sized ensemble that includes a long-sleeved pullover overdress, an underdress skirt, a belt, a veil, and a headpiece. The overdress is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features a deep back opening with large, loose overlock stitching. The neck and back opening close with a single piece of hook and loop fastener at the back of a two-piece stand collar. The overdress has ankle-length shoulder drapes and long sleeves, all with raw, unfinished edges. The overdress also has three slits cut into the front: two side slits reaching to the hip and one center slit reaching to the waist, which make the underdress skirt visible. The hem bottom edge of the overdress is also raw and unfinished.

title: Segmented Screw Clamps
facts: These are steel clamps made through drop-forging and sandblasting. Each clamp includes upper and lower jaws with lips that fit around flange surfaces, and a central screw mechanism that tightens or loosens the jaws. They are designed to secure flanges on pressure vessels in processing plants, allowing tank covers, manways, port holes, and flange openings to be fastened without drilling and tapping bolt holes into the vessel surfaces. The clamps come in various sizes and finishes. They function as part of a larger assembly and are not intended for independent use. The clamps are imported as standalone items, intended for integration into processing plant equipment.

title: Skeleton Spider Kit
facts: The Skeleton Spider Kit contains one free-standing 40-inch plastic skeleton spider and three free-standing 13.625-inch plastic skeleton spiders, all constructed from white plastic. The kit also includes an LED black light measuring approximately 4.25 inches in length, 2.75 inches in depth, and 3.25 inches in height, which plugs into a standard power source. When the black light is activated, it emits ultraviolet light that causes the white plastic spiders to glow. The kit is designed for both indoor and outdoor use as a seasonal decoration, specifically intended to create a spooky atmosphere during Halloween. The components are sold together as a complete kit for decorative purposes.

title: Steel Turnover Rack
facts: The article is a steel turnover rack designed for internal workshop use during manufacturing. It is constructed from Q235 carbon steel and forms a rectangular network of members. The rack includes five groups of parallel columns rising from a horizontal base, with two groups equipped with hooks at the top. Its dimensions are 6000 millimeters in length, 1100 millimeters in width, and 900 millimeters in height. The rack functions to load and transport aluminum profiles within the workshop environment.

title: Hydraulic Pipe for Truck Bed Crane
facts: This is a hydraulic pipe identified by SKU 549-6706, designed for use in the hydraulic system of a Hiab Hipro 425 crane, specifically within the stabilizer arms. The pipe is constructed from E355 steel, a low-alloy, high-strength structural steel that conforms to the EN10305 standard. It has an outer diameter of 12 millimeters, an inner diameter of 9 millimeters, and a wall thickness of 1.5 millimeters. The pipe begins as a straight component and is bent into the required shape for the crane's stabilizer arms. The ends of the pipe are flared to interface with threaded connectors. This component assists in maintaining stability during lifting operations by supporting the crane's weight without lifting the vehicle's wheels off the ground, thus helping to keep the chassis balanced during use.

title: Unassembled I.V. Flush Syringe Kits
facts: These are kits containing all components needed to assemble a single 12ml syringe: a plastic barrel, a plunger, a grommet (stopper), and a tip cap. The kits are supplied unassembled, packaged in bulk master cartons for wholesale distribution. After importation, the components are fitted together to form a complete syringe, which is later filled with 0.9 percent saline solution for intravenous use. The syringes are intended for medical applications, typically used by healthcare professionals in clinical settings. Each kit is identical in construction and components, designed to be assembled into a functional syringe of uniform specifications.

title: Fiberglass Swimming Pool Shells
facts: These are molded swimming pool shells intended for permanent in-ground installation. Each shell is constructed from fiberglass-reinforced polyester resin with an average thickness ranging from 3.17 mm to 3.50 mm and finished with a gel coat. The three models are: Lagoon Pool measuring 7.00 x 3.50 x 1.40 meters and weighing approximately 335 kg with a capacity of 34,300 liters; Haven Pool measuring 6.00 x 3.00 x 1.40 meters and weighing approximately 295 kg with a capacity of 25,200 liters; and Cove Pool measuring 5.00 x 2.50 x 1.40 meters and weighing approximately 268 kg with a capacity of 17,500 liters. The shells are supplied without pumps, filters, piping, lighting, drains, ladders, skimmers, or any mechanical or electrical components. They arrive as single molded structures designed solely to hold water once installed.

title: Girl’s Fleece Knit Blouse
facts: This is an upper body garment designed for girls, made from a fleece knit fabric that is 55% cotton and 45% polyester. The fabric is lightly napped on its inner surface, and the outer surface has more than nine stitches per two centimeters in the direction the stitches were formed. The blouse has a round crew neckline with a rib knit collar, long sleeves with rib knit cuffs, and a rib knit straight hem at the bottom. It will be imported in sizes ranging from XS through XXL.

title: Rifle Magazine Speed Loader
facts: The rifle magazine speed loader is a handheld accessory made from either carbon fiber reinforced nylon or glass fiber reinforced high-performance polyamide with brass hardware. It features a lightweight, collapsible design with two hinged connections that allow it to be carried easily. In the collapsed transport position, it measures 4.3 inches in length, 1.8 inches in width, and 1.1 inches in height, weighing 2.6 ounces. When expanded for use, its width increases to 4.25 inches. The device is used to rapidly load and unload 30-round NATO Standardization Agreement (STANAG) Armalite Rifle (AR) pattern magazines for 5.56 x 45 mm, .223 Remington, or .300 AAC ammunition, as well as metal or polymer stripper clips. It includes a takedown pin punch to assist with rifle disassembly and enables loading a magazine in under 10 seconds by expanding hinged arms to hold stripped ammunition, which is then pushed into the magazine in a single motion when attached to the magazine's open end.

title: IRA1 Upholstered Seat
facts: The IRA1 is a single-person upholstered seat attached to a solid American hardwood and Canadian plywood frame. The seat foundation, backrest, and armrests are made from these woods, while the seat and backrest cushions consist of compression foam covered in custom-ordered fabric. The seat does not include a recline mechanism, wall outlets, or USB charging ports. Exposed wooden legs are positioned at each corner of the base. The seat measures 29 inches in width, 28 inches in depth, and 31 inches in height, with a weight of approximately 60 pounds.

title: Cyclohexylamine
facts: The product is cyclohexylamine, identified by CAS Number 108-91-8, supplied in bulk form with a purity of approximately 99.7 percent. It is a cyclic monoamine, used primarily as a chemical intermediate in industrial applications. The production process involves aniline or related intermediates. The product is provided in bulk packaging suitable for chemical processing, without any consumer-ready features or end-user applications.

title: Vehicle Steering Wheel Electronic Control Unit
facts: This product is an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) designed for installation in a vehicle steering wheel. It consists of a central printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) that includes a microcontroller and various electrical components. Multiple wire harnesses are attached to the PCBA. The entire assembly is enclosed in a plastic housing. Once installed, the ECU connects to steering wheel functions such as heads-up display, heater elements, and drive unit through the wire harnesses. The microcontroller receives input from vehicle sensors and driver interactions and directs those signals to appropriate vehicle systems.

title: Wi-Fi Extension Cord
facts: The product is a Wi-Fi controlled extension cord identified by part number 88154. It consists of a length of insulated 16 AWG cable conductor. One end terminates in a 3-prong plug, while the opposite end features three 3-prong receptacles. Midway along the cable is a Wi-Fi module that includes a manual switch. This module interfaces with a mobile application, enabling the user to remotely switch the power flow on or off. The power can also be controlled using the manual switch on the module. The device is packaged and sold as a single unit.

title: Stainless-Steel Belleville Washer
facts: The article is a stainless-steel Belleville washer with a circular shape and a central hole. It has an outer diameter of 3 inches, an internal diameter of 1.755 inches, and a thickness of 0.133 inches. The washer is made from stainless steel and has uniform thickness. It is designed to distribute load and reduce surface damage when used with threaded fasteners. The washer is intended for use underneath a nut or screw head to maintain tension and functions as a lock washer, conforming to industry standards for spring washers.

title: Sneaky Horse Pull Bars
facts: These are four models of pull bars: SQ5520060 Disc Spring Pull Bar, SQ3255048 Bushing Bar, SQ5901839 Spring Bar, and SQ5717810 Disc Bar. Each pull bar is constructed from three steel plates. One plate has three linear bearings attached with socket cap screws to guide the main shaft along three equal-length rods. Another plate contains a linear bearing connected to an aluminum housing with socket caps to support the shaft. The third plate fastens the bar end to a spherical heim joint. The bars are designed for installation in motor vehicle suspension systems to control axle housing rotation from drivetrain torque and maintain suspension geometry. They are calibrated for specific mounting positions on the rear end to the chassis. These pull bars are used primarily in modified dirt race cars such as IMCA, USMTS, Wissota, USRA, and UMP, and are also compatible with three-link or five-link rear suspensions in various race vehicles and dirt cars.

title: Child Size Costumes
facts: The first item is a child size long-sleeved, skirted jumpsuit with a stand collar and a deep back opening closed by two small tabs of hook and loop fastener. The jumpsuit features large, visible, loose overlock stitching on the back opening, sleeves, leg openings, and attached skirt. The waist is a flimsy half-elastic strip of narrow exposed elastic stitched directly to the back. The second item is a child size long-sleeved jacket with edges folded over once and stitched with a single line of very long, loose, straight stitching, a two-piece collar, and closed front with a small strip of hook and loop fastener. The jacket has a raw, unfinished jagged cut edge at the hem bottom. The set also includes a belt, earrings, and fingerless gloves, though the belt and earrings were not enclosed with the sample.

title: Matelassé Quilt - Leaf
facts: This is a quilt-like bed covering made from a double woven fabric that contains 70 percent cotton and 30 percent polyester. The fabric is yarn-dyed and held together by yarns that travel back and forth between two faces. The top face has sections with additional 2-ply filling yarns creating a botanical design impression, causing areas without extra yarns to pucker. Between the two faces is a layer of 100 percent polyester stuffer yarns inserted during weaving to add bulk, cushioning, and a quilted surface effect without actual quilting. The bed covering is folded and hemmed along all four edges. The sample measures 90 by 92 inches, designed for use as a lightweight sleeping layer on a queen-size bed. It will be imported for retail sale and packaged in a polyethylene bag.

title: Costume Accessory Kits
facts: The product is an assortment of three costume accessory kits: the Clown Kit, the Prison Kit, and the Nerd Kit. The Clown Kit contains a red foam nose, a multicolored polka dot bowtie made from man-made textile, and a pair of multicolored polka dot suspenders made from man-made textile. The Prison Kit includes a black and white striped flat top convict cap made from man-made textile with a prisoner number printed on the front, and a pair of black and white striped suspenders made from man-made textile. The Nerd Kit features a pair of red plaid suspenders made from man-made textile, a red plaid bowtie made from man-made textile, and a pair of black plastic eyeglass frames without lenses. All items are supplied as kits for personal or theatrical use.

title: Plastic Water Globe
facts: The product is a 45-millimeter-diameter water globe constructed from polyvinyl chloride (PVC) plastic. Each globe contains a decorative marine animal figure, including varieties such as a shark, flamingo, dolphin, or sea turtle. The globes are supplied in display boxes containing twelve units each. They are intended for resale to retail customers within the souvenir industry, including locations such as beach stores, boutiques, and hotels.

title: Industrial Mixing System for Sealants, Adhesives, and Coatings
facts: The product is an industrial mixing system designed for the production of sealants, adhesives, and coatings such as silicone, acrylic, and polyurethane. Each system includes a vacuum butterfly mixer with a vacuum system, a human-machine interface, an electrical cabinet, a vacuum pump, dosing units for chalk or silica, a powder dosing pump, a screw conveyor/feeder, four stainless steel mixing containers, a hydraulic container press, an integrated floor scale, and various electrical panels and cabinets. The system operates semi-autonomously under human supervision, mixing liquid and solid raw materials under controlled conditions of speed, pressure, and temperature to form a homogeneous mass. Liquid raw materials are fed from external tank farms, while chalk and silica are dosed from big bags or super sacks. The mixer shaft can be equipped with attachments such as a butterfly mixer and a dissolver disc. The complete system is imported in multiple containers within a single shipment, with some components potentially unassembled at the time of importation.

title: Macrowave Oven
facts: The Macrowave Oven is a flatbed countertop unit measuring 15 X 23 X 21 inches with a capacity of 25.5 liters. It combines microwave, air fryer, and toaster oven functions, each operable independently or together within the same housing. The unit is rated at 1,000W at 120 volts and features a 7-inch one-touch control panel for household operation. Designed for domestic use, it operates at standard household speeds and is intended for cooking and reheating food through multiple cooking methods in one device.

title: Steel and Bamboo Suction Cup Bathroom Racks
facts: These bathroom racks are made from steel wire and include a bamboo insert at the bottom. The bamboo insert features diagonal slots for drainage. Each rack has a flat steel railing at the top to secure items placed on it and two 'S' hooks hanging from the bottom wire for additional storage. They include thermoplastic elastomer (TPE) suction cups for attaching to shower walls or other vertical surfaces. One model is a soap saver with a single TPE suction cup, while others include two TPE suction cups. A separate hook model is made of steel with one TPE suction cup and contains no bamboo.

title: Snowfall stone
facts: The product is a natural stone material known as Snowfall stone, originating from Brazil. It appears in ivory and cream colors with amber and black streaks. Each piece measures approximately 115 to 122 inches in length, 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. The stone’s surface is polished and the edges are beveled for a finished appearance. Laboratory analysis confirms the material is granite. After importation, the stone will be cut to specific sizes and shapes for use as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and office furniture tops.

title: Man’s Sneaker
facts: This is a below-the-ankle man's sneaker with a textile upper that constitutes the majority of the external surface area, complemented by leather accents. The outer sole is made of rubber/plastic with a modified 'lug' design, providing lightweight flexibility and traction suitable for athletic pursuits. The sole overlaps the upper material by ½ inch, forming a foxing-like band. The sneaker features laces for closure over a separate tongue, ensuring a secure fit. The footwear is designed for general use, including athletic activities, and the FOB value per pair is $17.45.

title: Empty Electrical Conduit Box
facts: The item is an empty electrical conduit or junction box, Model # EG4-280Ah-AW, designed to protect electrical components from external elements. It is constructed from steel and measures 24.13 inches in length, 10.57 inches in width, and 9.06 inches in height, weighing 16.85 lbs. The box features threaded mounts for wall installation, knockouts on the top, left, and right panels for customizing configurations, and an access panel secured with a latch and locking mechanism on the right side, attached via two metal hinges. At importation, the box will be empty, containing no electronic components.

title: RoadLoft Minivan Camper Conversion Kit
facts: The RoadLoft Minivan Camper Conversion Kit is constructed from poplar plywood and designed to temporarily convert an SUV into a camper van. The kit includes a satin-finished bedframe that holds a sectional high-density polyurethane foam mattress positioned on the platform. It features slide-out storage compartments for storing items and overlaps the rear seating of the vehicle. The kit weighs approximately 62 lbs and measures 72 inches in length, 48 inches in width above the seats, and 40 inches in width in the trunk, with an adjustable height ranging from 9.75 to 15.75 inches.

title: Athletic Groin Protectors
facts: These are athletic groin protectors, also known as protective cups, designed for use during sports activities to shield the genital area from impact injuries. Two sizes are available: one for adults and older teens (16 years and older) and another for younger children (7 to 12 years old). Each protector features a rigid plastic shell with an attached soft lining and a soft edge frame. An elastic cord is included to secure the protector to an athletic support garment. The design and sizing consider the age and gender of the intended user to ensure proper fit and protection.

title: Domino Picnic Table with Bench Seating
facts: The Domino Picnic Table is a circular table with an integrated set of three bench seats, designed for permanent outdoor installation in public or private spaces such as parks, plazas, and commercial areas. The frame and bench seats are constructed from carbon steel or stainless steel, while the tabletop and bench seat surfaces are made from either hardwood, softwood, or high-pressure laminate planks with rectangular cross-sections. The table has a diameter of 65 inches, a height of 30 inches, and bench seats with an 18-inch height and depth, accommodating up to nine individuals. The table features a flat, level surface for placing objects and a central opening for an umbrella (not included). The unit can be used freestanding or anchored to the ground with expansion bolts. It is imported fully manufactured and assembled, with no further processing required after importation.

title: Penrose Bench
facts: The Penrose Bench is an urban bench intended for permanent installation in public and private outdoor environments such as parks, streetscapes, plazas, campuses, and commercial developments. The bench frame is constructed from galvanized and powder-coated carbon and stainless steel. The seat foundation surface is made from either hardwood, softwood, or high-pressure laminate (HPL) planks with rectangular cross-sections, featuring 18 planks ranging in length from approximately 18.5 inches to 28 inches. The bench incorporates a 66-gallon planter. The overall dimensions of the seating and planter components are 108 7/8 inches in width, 35 1/16 inches in depth, and 17 15/16 inches in height. The bench requires anchoring to the floor or ground using attaching bolts. It will be imported fully manufactured and assembled, with no further processing or transformation after U.S. importation.

title: Household Knife Sharpeners
facts: These are manual, pull-through knife sharpeners designed for household kitchen use. Each model features multiple sharpening stages: coarse tungsten steel, diamond (diamond affixed to carbon steel or iron), and ceramic slots to repair dull blades, add fine edges, and achieve razor-sharp edges. The sharpeners include an integrated ceramic shear sharpener for kitchen scissors on one model. The bodies are primarily constructed from acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) plastic, with components of stainless steel, thermoplastic rubber (TPR), polyoxymethylene, and carbon steel for stability and grip. One model has an adjustable V-groove with a dial mechanism offering six preset angles to accommodate various knife types, while another features eight adjustable angles via a dial. All models have non-slip bases and ergonomic handles for stability and comfort during use. Each sharpener includes a removable iron beaded chain for hanging storage on one model. The items are lightweight, compact, and intended for use by adults in kitchen settings.

title: RIC2Discover Cattle Feeding and Watering System
facts: The RIC2Discover System is a complete cattle feeding and watering solution designed for use on research farms, universities, and dairy and beef farms collaborating with feed, genetic, or pharmaceutical companies. The system includes 18 stainless steel feed-weigh troughs equipped with RFID gates and 2 water-weigh troughs. A control system comprises management software, process controllers, interface cables, and zone units, supported by mounting poles, brackets, and an installation kit. The system uses RFID identification and integrated weighing technology to record individual animal feed and water intake. All components are designed to be assembled on-site, enabling automated monitoring and management of cattle nutrition.

title: Industrial Container Bomb Cart Trailer
facts: The item is a complete industrial trailer imported as a finished unit. It is non-propelled and designed to be towed by a terminal tractor. The trailer includes multiple axles, wheels, a suspension system, a braking system, a king pin, landing legs, and container guides. It does not perform any mechanical, lifting, or processing functions. The trailer is constructed to support and transport standard shipping containers.

title: Kewl-It Chiller
facts: The Kewl-It Chiller, model number KEWL-IT, is a beverage-cooling device designed for rapid chilling of standard canned or similar beverage containers in a home freezer. It consists of two aluminum components, both extruded with an Aluminum Association Series Designation of 6064. The device includes four stainless steel threaded knobs with an M5 stem size and a plastic handle. Its dimensions are approximately 9¼ inches long, 12 1/8 inches high, and 4 9/16 inches wide. The device is built to hold up to two 12-ounce standard-sized beverage cans or any other beverage container of comparable diameter and up to 12 inches in length.

title: Printed Reproduction of Abstract Artwork
facts: The item is a printed reproduction of an original abstract painting created by the artist Parbbonni. The reproduction is digitally printed on canvas and then stretched over wooden stretcher bars. It features an external synthetic resin frame and measures approximately 58 inches by 58 inches. Each piece is a limited-edition print, hand-signed by the artist on the reverse side with the edition number.

title: Used Spark-Ignition Internal Combustion Piston Engine
facts: This is a spark-ignition internal combustion piston engine identified as the BMW S65B40A, designed for installation in BMW E90, E92, E93, or M3 vehicle chassis. The engine is a 4.0 liter (4,000cc) V8 configuration, rated at 420 horsepower. It is a used component, previously installed in motor vehicles, and is presented for potential reuse or repair. The engine operates on gasoline and uses a piston-driven mechanism to convert fuel into mechanical power. It includes all necessary components for operation such as cylinders, crankshaft, valves, and associated hardware, and is sold individually without any packaging or accessories beyond what is required for handling and transport.

title: Hydraulic Cylinder and Actuator for Agricultural Seeder
facts: The hydraulic cylinder, part number 995310040 from Ognibene (equivalent to Deere part number AA114802), is a component used in agricultural seeders. It converts pressurized hydraulic fluid into linear mechanical force to control the seeder's depth, position, and operational state, enabling precise and uniform seed placement for crop yield. The actuator, part number 995310080 from Ognibene (equivalent to Deere part number BU47768), is also used in agricultural seeders. It converts energy into precise mechanical motion to automate key tasks such as controlling seeding depth, regulating seed and fertilizer dosage rates, and adjusting row markers. This actuator enhances accuracy in precision farming, reduces waste, and optimizes crop yields by replacing hydraulic systems with maintenance-free electric solutions. It allows for real-time adjustment of downforce as soil conditions change and precisely moves dosing units to control the exact amount of seed or fertilizer dispensed. The actuator also deploys and retracts markers that designate furrow lanes, helping operators maintain optimal seeding patterns.

title: Pre-Install Kit for EUV Semiconductor Photolithography System
facts: The Pre-Install Kit, part number 3800E PRE-INS-SETS, is designed for ASML’s NXE 3800E EUV semiconductor photolithography system. It consists of a Service Floor with mounting brackets, plates, nuts, bolts, mechanical and electrical connectors, seismic anchors, a smoke detector, and a pressure measurement assembly. The kit also includes subassemblies of metal valves, pipes, and both metal and flexible hoses. The Service Floor is a large, rigid, rectangular platform that provides structural support for the Main Cabinet and serves as the base for its attachment. It features channels, conduits, holes, and attachment points for cables, hoses, and pipes that connect to the sub-fab. The platform maintains proper alignment of the EUV equipment and dampens vibrations. The kit is imported complete but unassembled, intended for use in semiconductor manufacturing plants to support and connect the EUV system components.

title: Blue Phoenix Swift Racing Go-Kart Chassis
facts: The Blue Phoenix Swift is a racing go-kart chassis supplied in kit form, fully disassembled and without an engine or tires. The chassis is constructed from chrome-molybdenum (Cr-Mo) steel tubes. Certain outer body plastic components such as fenders, fender bumpers, and fairings are made in Italy, while all other components including the chassis are made in the Czech Republic. The kit contains all parts required for assembly into a functional go-kart. The finished go-kart is designed to accommodate several possible power plants: a 175cc two-stroke, a 100cc two-stroke, a 125cc two-stroke, a 196cc four-stroke, or an electric motor, depending on the driver’s chosen racing class. The go-kart is also designed for use with 10 x 4.50-5 tires, which are selected by the driver based on racing conditions and track type.

title: Metal Medallion Encapsulated in Plastic Card
facts: The product is a metal medallion permanently encapsulated in a rigid plastic card the size of a credit card. The medallion is made from a zinc alloy and features an embossed image of various subjects including dinosaurs, endangered animals, American sites, historical treasures, dogs, legendary cars, and the history of aviation. The plastic card displays an artistic image of the subject on the front and includes a short educational paragraph about the subject on the reverse side. The items are sold individually in themed limited editions for use as gifts, souvenirs, educational tools, novelties, and collectibles. Each unit consists of a metal coin component and a plastic card component.

title: Fuel Injector
facts: The article is a fuel injector identified by part number 0432191581. It consists of a housing that contains a spring, a plunger-like mechanism, and several other internal components. The injector is constructed primarily from steel. When a high-pressure pulse of fuel from a fuel injection pump activates it, the internal spring's tension is released, causing a controlled mist of fuel to be sprayed into the cylinder head of a vehicle. This component is designed for use specifically in marine diesel engines.

title: Orthodontic Wire-Bending Machines
facts: The Bender S, Bender Max, and Bender-L are specialized machines designed to bend medical-grade stainless steel wires into prescribed shapes for orthodontic appliance components such as retainers, labial bows, lingual arches, transpalatal arches, Nance arches, and clasps. The Bender S processes medical-grade short straight orthodontic wires, while the Bender Max processes medical-grade spool wires using a multi-wheel system to straighten the wire before bending. The Bender-L is designed specifically for medical-grade twisted orthodontic wires with a diameter of 0.5 mm. All three machines receive orthodontic wire design data from proprietary software that uses 3D dental tooth models to generate custom wire geometries. These machines are physically limited to feeding and bending medical-grade orthodontic wires with diameters below 1 mm. They are intended exclusively for use by dental orthodontic laboratories and dental professionals and are marketed and sold solely through dental and orthodontic industry channels.

title: Monster Scarecrow Adult Costume
facts: The costume includes a knee-length duster coat made from a flimsy, man-made knitted textile, a latex chest piece, latex hands, a rope belt, a hat, and a mask. The coat has a flat two-piece collar and a front opening with visible raw edges that are only partially turned back and not stitched, and it lacks any means of closure. The long sleeves and bottom hem feature raw, jagged cut edges and are stitched together with long, loose straight stitching. The costume is designed for adult wear and is sold as a complete set for retail sale.

title: Ghastly Gargoyle Child Costume
facts: This costume includes a long-sleeved, padded bodysuit, a hood, wings, and a mask for children. The bodysuit is made from a single layer of flimsy, knitted man-made textile. It features a stand collar with a single fold-over edge and large loose straight stitching. The deep back opening has one side folded over but not stitched, and the other side left raw and unfinished. The bodysuit closes with three small tabs of hook and loop fastener. Upper arm and chest areas are lightly padded and stitched with long, loose straight stitches. The sleeve ends and thumb holes, like the leg openings, are raw and unfinished.

title: Elven Archer Adult Costume
facts: The costume is an adult-sized ensemble that includes a long-sleeved, thigh-length pullover top referred to as a tunic, pull-on pants, a belt with a shoulder strap, a hooded shoulder cape, gauntlets, and a pair of artificial elf ears. The tunic is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features a raw unfinished neck, faux leather shoulder armor, and long sleeves with raw, unfinished edges. It includes a front slit and two side slits with raw, unfinished edges, and the bottom hem is also raw and unfinished. The shoulder armor edges have decorative capping, but the overall construction of the top remains flimsy, stitched together with a single row of long, loose straight stitching. The costume components are designed to be worn together for thematic or role-playing purposes.

title: Halloween Decoration
facts: The item is a decorative framed printed artwork measuring approximately 12 inches by 16 inches. It features an image of a restaurant guest check that includes printed images of flying bats and a ghost, along with the phrase 'Creep it Real' and the date 10/31. The design specifically references Halloween themes. The decoration is marketed and sold as Halloween decor in retail stores. It is intended for seasonal indoor display to create a Halloween atmosphere.

title: Digital Torpedo Level Body
facts: The item is the body of a digital torpedo level made from clear polycarbonate with a permanently attached magnet on the bottom. The body is pre-manufactured and sized to serve as the complete structure for the digital level, featuring cutouts for bubble levels and a compartment for electronic components. The finished level includes an electronic center section that illuminates green when level, horizontally or vertically, and shows red LED lights when off-level. The electronic section has an on/off button and LED indicators and is powered by a single AA battery. The level also includes traditional bubble levels, with a vertical bubble on the left and a horizontal bubble on the right. These twelve-inch levels are designed for precision work by carpenters and DIY enthusiasts.

title: Multi-Channel Video Signal Harness Assembly
facts: The item is a wiring harness assembly identified as Part No. PAS-QFT-001. It is constructed from multiple insulated copper coaxial conductors that are bundled together. The assembly features Fakra-type connectors on one end and BNC connectors on the other end. This harness functions exclusively as a signal transmission apparatus with no active electronic components, performing no signal processing, amplification, or modification. It is designed for installation in commercial vehicle recording and display systems, connecting external cameras to in-vehicle recording and display equipment. The harness enables multiple cameras to be connected and viewed within the vehicle. The product is supplied as a standalone assembly ready for installation.

title: Decorative Artificial Wreath
facts: The item is a decorative artificial wreath with the item number 492394. The wreath features black and dark purple leaves and flowers, purple pumpkins, and a black snake attached to a molded black base. The pumpkins, snake, and base are made from plastic. The leaves and flowers are constructed from 100% polyester fabric. The elements are bound together with wire and assembled using glue. The wreath has a diameter of approximately 24 inches. It is intended for decorative use and may be used for occasions other than Halloween.

title: Ultimate Sideline Wagon
facts: The Ultimate Sideline Wagon is a portable unit combining two collapsible seats with a collapsible wagon. It features an aluminum metal frame for the seats and a steel frame for the wagon. Seat foundations, backrests, armrests, cupholders, and the wagon's storage cavity are made from 600D polyester canvas and woven nylon mesh fabric. The seats and wagon form a single unit that cannot be separated. The wagon includes a pull handle and four oversized plastic wheels, and remains stationary when the seats are extended. It is designed for outdoor activities such as camping, hunting, fishing, beach trips, concerts, and sporting events. Each seat measures 18 inches in width and 14 inches in depth, while the wagon measures 23.5 inches in width, 15 inches in depth, and 15 inches in height.

title: Orbital Sprinkler Sets
facts: These are two types of home garden sprinklers imported from China. The first is a 3-arm metal telescoping sprinkler on a metal step spike, Orbit part number 27770, featuring an aluminum sprinkler head, aluminum fittings, an aluminum Hi-Rise shaft, an aluminum step spike, a polypropylene lock fitting, and a polypropylene hose cap. Its telescoping riser adjusts in height from 21.37 inches to 33.37 inches and covers up to 2,000 square feet with a 360-degree spray pattern, controlled solely by water pressure without a valve. The second is a MAX rotating sprinkler, Orbit part number 56071, constructed from an aluminum base, acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) plastic body, and a zinc female swivel retainer, with each arm equipped with three adjustable spray nozzles offering fan, shower, and four-nozzle patterns. Both sprinklers include a flow-through coupling with brass threaded ends for attaching to a garden hose or linking multiple sprinklers, each coupling equipped with a removable cap. The items are designed for residential lawn and garden irrigation.

title: RestoreLab Therapeutic Vibration Foot Massager
facts: The RestoreLab therapeutic vibration foot massager is a compact platform designed for seated or reclined use, intended to support relaxation, circulation, recovery, and tissue healing. It features molded zones for foot, calf, and limb placement, a control panel with preset therapeutic modes labeled ARMS/SHOULDERS, CALVES, and THIGHS, a power button, decrease and increase buttons, a display screen showing vibration speed and remaining treatment time, a start/stop button, and a lock button. The device includes four non-slip suction-cup feet on the bottom to remain stationary during use and six position-adjustment legs to tilt the product forward or backward. It has a collapsible handle for positioning and is powered by a regular AC adapter via a power cord. The platform’s small footprint, low profile, and lightweight construction make it suitable only for seated or targeted body placement use, not for standing or exercise routines.

title: Unisex Fishing Vest
facts: The item is a unisex fishing vest identified as style 81950, also known as the Dry Line Vest. The front panels, back yolk, and lumbar area are made from 100% nylon woven fabric with a visible polyurethane coating on the inner surface. The remainder of the garment, including the lining, is composed of 100% polyester mesh knit fabric. The vest features a full-frontal opening secured with an adjustable buckle closure. It includes three pouches with hook and loop closure on each front panel, an inside pocket with a zipper closure at the left chest, additional inside pockets with zipper closures at the waist area, and a pocket with a zipper closure on the lumbar panel.

title: 1984 Toyota Land Cruiser BJ42 LX Diesel
facts: This is a 1984 model Toyota Land Cruiser BJ42 LX Diesel vehicle imported from Japan, identified by VIN JTIV0BJ42009XXXX. The vehicle features three doors and is powered by a diesel engine. It is designed for on-road and light off-road use, suitable for adult drivers and passengers. The vehicle includes standard automotive components such as wheels, tires, braking system, steering, lighting, and interior seating for multiple occupants. It is equipped for typical passenger transportation and comes in standard automotive packaging for delivery and retail.

title: Plastic Zip Tie
facts: The item is a standard plastic zip tie measuring 0.10 inches thick and 4 inches long, identified by SKU number 309-00002-000.A1. It is manufactured from plastic and formed through an injection molding process. The zip tie features a head and a strip with a ratcheting mechanism that allows it to be fastened around objects and secured tightly. It will be used in the production of aviation headsets. The product is supplied loose, without any packaging, and sold in bulk quantities for industrial use.

title: FF Holder Gasket
facts: The FF Holder Gasket, SKU number 305-00021-000.A1, is constructed from polyurethane plastic foam. It is used during the assembly of aviation headsets. The gasket serves to mount and seal the external environment microphone. Its functions include providing acoustic isolation, ensuring mechanical stability, maintaining environmental sealing, and supporting active noise reduction system accuracy.

title: Essential Film Holder and Components
facts: The product is a device made entirely of plastic, consisting of an acrylic main body and nylon components including posts, spacers, lock nuts, wing nuts, and non-slip feet. It is designed to hold and position 35mm and 120mm photographic film flat and aligned for digital reproduction. The device functions with an external light source and a separate digital camera placed above it, and contains no metal, glass, optical elements, electronic parts, integrated lighting, or image capture capability. Additionally included are interchangeable masks that fit the device, and replacement mask layers for use with the system. The items are supplied as a complete set for use in photographic laboratory settings.

title: Aviation Headset Control Components
facts: These are three separate parts for the Lightspeed Zulu 3 aviation headset. The first is a volume slider knob made from a thermoplastic blend of polycarbonate and acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene, mounted on the control box assembly to adjust an internal potentiometer slide controller by sliding up and down. The second is a microphone housing pot cover made from molded ABS-PC, fitted over the mic boom to adjust microphone gain and control voice amplification levels. The third is a Bluetooth control button also made from molded ABS-PC, attached to the control box assembly to activate an internal Bluetooth switch on the printed circuit board assembly. All three components are small, solid plastic parts designed for direct integration into the headset's electronic control box or microphone boom assembly.

title: Tire Carousel
facts: The Tire Carousel is a commercial maintenance garage rack designed for storing, retrieving, handling, loading, and unloading vehicle tires. It is constructed from steel and includes gears, chains, a drive shaft, and push button controls integrated into two vertical steel frame towers and seven horizontal round steel tube frame carrier rails. Each carrier rail has a partition and holds up to 13 tires with diameters up to 44 inches. The structure features 2-inch wire mesh guards on the upper front and rear of the steel frame. Powered by a 208V, 15-amp, 60Hz, 3-phase motor, the unit measures 20 feet 3 inches in height, 14 feet 11 inches in width, and 9 feet 1 inch in depth, with an overall weight capacity of approximately 8,000 pounds. At the time of importation, the unit is unassembled and shipped via flatbed trailer. Optional configurations such as a tire loading ramp, tire carrier insert, motorized system for heavy tires, duplicate control center, variable frequency drive, electrical configuration change, color change, horizontal security gate, and full enclosure are available but not included in the base model.

title: Aviation Headset Battery Module Subassembly
facts: The item is a battery module subassembly identified by part number 260-00061-000.A6 for use in the control box of an aviation headset. It consists of a printed circuit board assembly and a single 18650 lithium-ion battery cell. These components are enclosed in a protective plastic housing that fits the control box body and aligns with its electrical contacts. The battery operates at a nominal voltage of 3.7 VDC and provides a nominal capacity of 2,600 mAh. The assembly is supplied as a single unit ready for integration into the headset's control box.

title: Personalized Decorative Wooden Plaque Set
facts: The item is a decorative plaque made from medium density fiberboard (MDF) for the back panel and laser-cut poplar plywood pieces glued onto the front. Plaque sizes range from 12” x 9” to 30” x 24”. Each plaque is hand-painted and may feature laser-engraved designs, such as silhouettes and leaf shapes, along with personalized text. The set includes two permanent markers for writing messages on the plaque and a plywood stand to display the plaque upright on a shelf. Some sets may also include a smaller, laser-engraved plaque with a message like 'Please sign our guest book.' The components are packaged together for direct retail sale to end users.

title: Two-Piece Range Hood Covers
facts: These are custom-made, non-functional covers consisting of a wood hood canopy top and a wood hood canopy base that together form a range hood cover. They are constructed from standard wood species (excluding exotic woods), medium density fiberboard (MDF), particle board, and melamine. The covers vary in size and complexity, ranging from simple to more intricate designs. They are generally secured to the ceiling during installation and serve to obscure a range hood or fan, providing a decorative continuity with cabinetry. The components are made through standard woodworking processes and are sold as a set for residential or commercial kitchen use.

title: Coconut Cream and Coconut Milk
facts: These products are liquid preparations made from coconut extract and water, each containing stabilizing additives. The coconut cream variants contain 22-24% fat and are composed of approximately 70-80% coconut extract, with the remainder being water and small percentages of xanthan gum, guar gum, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, and polysorbate 60. The light coconut milk contains 5-7% fat and is composed of approximately 40% coconut extract, 59.3% water, and 0.7% guar gum. The coconut milk contains 17-18% fat and is composed of approximately 75% organic coconut extract, 24.7% water, and 0.3% organic guar gum. Both the coconut cream and coconut milk are manufactured by extracting coconut meat, washing, blanching, grating, squeezing, and undergoing vibration filtration and preheating. After filtration, stabilizing additives are mixed in, followed by homogenization and UHT sterilization, then aseptic packaging for transport. The coconut cream is intended for use as an ingredient in foods and beverages, while the coconut milk can be used as an ingredient or as a dairy milk replacement in smoothies, teas, and other applications.

title: Robotic Pool Skimmer
facts: This is a solar-powered surface cleaning robot designed for automatic pool maintenance. It continuously collects floating debris such as leaves, insects, and dust from the water surface. The device features a hybrid power system combining solar energy with a built-in battery for all-weather operation. When the battery level is low, the robot automatically seeks sunlight to recharge and then resumes cleaning. It includes a roller brush and anti-spill baffle structure to capture and secure debris, with collected waste stored in a removable filter basket for easy rinsing and cleaning. The skimmer also has a chlorine tablet box for additional pool water quality balancing. The device weighs 12.6 pounds and measures 21 inches long by 16 inches wide by 8 inches high. It is supplied with a charger, user manual, and a foam noodle to prevent jamming at the skimmer port.

title: Snowplow Blade and Push Tube Assembly
facts: The snowplow blade, part number 459-5072, is constructed from steel and measures 72 inches in width, featuring a rubber flap along its top edge. The push tube attachment, part number 459-6300, is a frame-like assembly that serves as a structural link between the snowplow blade and the vehicle's frame. This push tube includes a mechanical latch assembly for manual height adjustment of the snow blade and quick-release pins for tool-free mounting and dismounting. Both components are designed for use with all-terrain vehicles or utility terrain vehicles as part of the Open Trail snowplow system. The snowplow blade and push tube assembly are imported in separate packaging and are sold individually, allowing end users to assemble customized packages for their specific vehicles.

title: Folding Paperboard Box
facts: The item is a folding solid bleached sulfate paperboard box identified by SKU 316-00018-000.A1. It measures approximately 124mm in length, 27mm in width, and 39mm in height. The box assembles by a glued tab located along one long side. The container’s design allows it to form the other sides through its own construction, with possible use of additional adhesive tape or staples to secure the bottom or lid if needed. It is intended for packaging purposes and is supplied flat for assembly at the point of use.

title: Ibuprofen Tablets
facts: These are solid oral dosage form tablets containing ibuprofen as the active ingredient, supplied in strengths of 600 mg and 800 mg per tablet. The tablets are manufactured for human consumption to relieve mild to moderate pain, reduce fever, and decrease inflammation. They are intended for use by adults and children as directed by a healthcare professional. The tablets are packaged in blister packs or bottles for retail or institutional sale.

title: Pokémon Trading Cards
facts: These are individual trading cards featuring unique artwork and game information, printed on standard card stock measuring approximately 63mm x 88mm. Each card is packaged either in a clear plastic sleeve or a rigid case. The cards are designed as game pieces for the Pokémon Trading Card Game, a competitive strategic game. They are intended for collectors but are inherently functional as game components within the Pokémon Trading Card Game ecosystem.

title: Replica Volkswagen Van
facts: This is a custom-built replica of the iconic 1960s and 1970s Volkswagen Microbus, manufactured in China. The vehicle can be equipped with either an internal combustion engine or electric motors; this specific unit uses a 4KW electric motor. It is designed for use as a mobile food cart at locations such as theme parks, hotels, and similar facilities. The electric version travels at speeds of 5 to 10 miles per hour and, while intended as a mostly stationary fixture, retains the ability to be moved within its operating area. The vehicle’s capacity and specifications can vary based on buyer preference.

title: Aviation Headset Cable
facts: This product is a cable identified by part number 300-00037-002.A2. It features a length of insulated cable with a 5POS connector on one end and two stereo plugs—one for audio input and one for audio output—on the other end. The cable is designed to establish an electrical connection between the headset’s control box and the aircraft’s intercom system. It functions exclusively to transmit audio signals and does not carry power. The cable is intended for use in aviation settings, connecting pilot or crew headsets to aircraft communication systems.

title: Backing Plate Adapter
facts: The item is a backing plate adapter that includes two separate steel components: a hex drive shaft and a backing plate. These parts are shipped unassembled for efficiency. After import, they undergo an orbital forming process where pressure flattens the end of the hex drive shaft against the backing plate, creating a permanent connection. Following assembly, the adapter is over-molded with foam and fitted with hook-and-loop material to form a backing pad assembly. The finished adapter is designed to hold 3-inch polishing, buffing, or abrasive discs and is intended for use with hand-held power tools such as polishers or drills.

title: Stainless Steel Housing for Pedestrian Crosswalk Marker
facts: The item is a stainless steel housing identified as Part Number M12 Housing, version v121724-3. It serves as the outer casing for an LED-based signaling device used in roadway crosswalk warning systems. The housing will be combined with a black fiberglass reinforced thermoplastic inner casing that contains both amber and white LED light modules. The amber LEDs flash to alert drivers from up to 1,000 feet away, while the white LEDs emit a steady light toward pedestrians during the crossing phase. This device is designed for permanent installation within roadway crosswalks to enhance pedestrian visibility and safety. The unit operates electronically and is supplied ready for in-ground mounting without additional components required.

title: VIPER 5806V LED 2-Way Security + Remote Start System
facts: The product is sold as a complete set that includes two wireless radio remote control key fobs, vehicle harnesses, a control module, and a siren.
