The key fobs are used to remotely send signals that arm or lock the vehicle, disarm or unlock it, open the auxiliary or trunk, and start the engine from a distance. Each key fob features LED indicators and is designed for use with vehicles, typically automobiles. The set is packaged together for retail or direct sales and is intended for consumers who want to enhance vehicle security and remote operation. All components are made from standard electronic and plastic materials, with the key fobs measuring approximately 2.5 inches in length and weighing about 3 ounces each. The system operates using radio frequency signals and is powered by standard batteries installed in the key fobs.

title: CISC RFID and NFC Test and Measurement Devices
facts: These are high-precision test and measurement instruments designed for evaluating RFID and NFC devices and tags. The CISC RFID Xplorer operates in the UHF band (700 MHz to 1.2 GHz) and measures tag sensitivity, communication range, backscatter power, and radiation patterns. It connects to a PC via Ethernet for control using a GUI or API. The CISC RAIN Xplorer Inline 100 tests RAIN RFID tags in production lines, supporting reading, writing, encoding, and sensitivity measurements in the UHF band (800–1000 MHz) with USB and GPIO interfaces for machine integration. The CISC NFC Xplorer 110 functions at 13.56 MHz for HF RFID and NFC testing, providing measurements of load modulation, activation field strength, and protocol decoding. It also connects to a PC via Ethernet. The CISC NFC Xplorer Inline operates at 13.56 MHz for high-speed testing of NFC labels and inlays in manufacturing, supporting read, write, encoding, and authentication with USB and GPIO interfaces for automated production line integration. All devices generate controlled RF test signals for laboratory, engineering, certification, and quality assurance use, serving developers, test laboratories, manufacturers, and inspection facilities.

title: Floor Type Pedestrian Signal System
facts: The product is a Floor Type Pedestrian Signal System composed of three separate modules: a Display Unit (HGHC-24DE1), a Control Unit (HGHC-24CE1), and an Interface Unit (HGHC-24EDIB01). The Display Unit is an LED signal light mounted on the ground at crosswalk waiting lines, showing steady or flashing green and red lights to guide pedestrians. The Control Unit receives signal status from an interface board and manages the on/off illumination of the Display Unit. The Interface Unit (EDIB) transfers timing data from an external traffic signal controller's CPU to the Control Unit. Together, these modules operate as an integrated system where the Interface Unit gathers real-time data, the Control Unit processes this data to control lighting, and the Display Unit shows the visual signal to pedestrians, improving safety and convenience at crosswalks.

title: Processed Bovine Meat Cuts
facts: The product consists of trimmed, whole-muscle cuts of bovine meat, including eye of round, top sirloin, rib lifter, bottom round flats, and chuck rolls. Before export, the meat undergoes a controlled marination and mechanical processing. It is vacuum tumbled with a preservative solution containing liquid vinegar, water, salt, sodium tripolyphosphate, garlic powder, and black pepper at an approximate pickup rate of 8 percent by weight. The solution is applied to penetrate the muscle structure and incorporate functional ingredients throughout the meat. After marination and tumbling, the products are vacuum packaged, placed into corrugated shipping containers, and exported to the United States in either refrigerated or frozen condition.

title: Decorative Wire Pumpkin
facts: The item is a decorative wire pumpkin, item number 305969 26-26X004. It consists of eight pieces of iron wire that form the structure of a pumpkin and an additional steel wire that ends in a spring-like shape to represent the stem at the top. An arrangement of autumn artificial foliage made of plastic, polyester, polyfoam, pinecone, and rattan is attached to the bottom center of the wire frame. The decorative wire pumpkin is composed of iron wire, steel wire, plastic, polyester, polyfoam, pinecone, and rattan. The iron wire provides the structure and visual appeal, while the artificial foliage enhances the decorative effect. The article is sold as a single decorative piece and is intended for indoor decorative use.

title: Steel Collars for Passenger Vehicle Suspension Systems
facts: These are steel collars identified by part numbers 11-267A-2 for Toyota RAV4, 11-309B-2 for Toyota Highlander, 12-344B-2 for Toyota Corolla, and 35-539A-2 for Nissan Pathfinder. Each collar features a specific shape with narrow necks on both ends and an expanded middle section, though sizes vary according to the vehicle model. They are designed for use in passenger vehicle suspension systems and will be encased in rubber after importation. The collars are intended for insertion into the front and rear control arms of the vehicles. All collars are made of steel and are sold individually, with each piece provided as a standalone component for automotive assembly.

title: Receptacle Subassembly Wiring Harness
facts: The item is a wiring harness identified by part number 229761. It consists of six individually insulated copper wire conductors. Each wire conductor is terminated at both ends with specific connectors suited for electrical connections. This subassembly is designed for installation inside the power supply housing of a plasma arc cutting machine. Its function is to transmit electrical current from the machine's power supply to the torch lead. The wires are arranged and fixed within a supportive structure to maintain proper spacing and orientation. The entire subassembly is supplied ready for integration into the host equipment.

title: Polyurethane Flooring Sheet
facts: The product is a solid extruded sheet made from polyurethane with a UV coating of acrylate. It is supplied in roll form for direct use. The flooring is applied by unrolling the sheet, cutting it to the required dimensions, and securing it to an existing surface using an adhesive. It is intended for commercial applications and requires no additional processing before installation. The material is durable and designed for easy installation on various surfaces.

title: ALRK-20BK Bakery Rack
facts: The ALRK-20BK Bakery Rack is a 20-tier storage rack made from aluminum and supplied unassembled. It features an aluminum frame designed for vertical stacking, preparation, baking, storage, and display of baked goods. The base includes two locking and two non-locking 5-inch caster wheels for mobility. The rack measures approximately 21 inches in length, 26.5 inches in width, and 70 inches in height. It has a weight capacity of 650 pounds. At the time of importation, the rack is unequipped with any wire mesh decking or pan holders.

title: Toddler Sleep Mat
facts: This product is a portable sleep mat for toddlers, measuring 22 x 53 ½ inches, constructed from an outer shell of 100 percent polyester printed woven fabric and stuffed with 100 percent polyester fiberfill. It features seven parallel rows of quilting spaced six inches apart and rounded corners bound with 100 percent polyester woven edging. The mat includes an integrated, unquilted pillowcase measuring 22 x 8 ½ inches with a left-side envelope closure and a removable pillow insert. A permanently attached blanket measuring 35 x 41 inches is sewn to the left edge, composed of a 100 percent polyester printed woven face fabric, a 100 percent polyester microfiber minky knit pile backing, and 100 percent polyester fiberfill stuffing, finished with a knife edge on three sides. The mat can be rolled and secured with 20-inch-long looped elasticized woven straps sewn to the bottom edge, and it includes a reinforced webbing handle sewn to the bottom end of the back for transport and storage. The item is offered in various printed designs and colors under the Sweet Jojo Designs® brand and is sold through their official website and various retailers.

title: Basalt Fiber Reinforced Exterior Panel Door
facts: The product is an exterior panel door made from a basalt fiber reinforced stone plastic composite that gives the appearance of a wooden door. The inner frame combines wood and polyvinyl chloride, with a core of polyurethane foam. The door's construction and operation are similar to those of a fiberglass door. It is designed for use as an exterior entrance door, providing structural strength and weather resistance. The door is supplied ready to install, with no additional components or packaging details specified.

title: IndeeLift People Picker Upper
facts: The IndeeLift People Picker Upper (model PPU-S) is a portable lifting device designed to assist individuals in moving from a lying or seated position on the floor to a sitting or standing position. It consists of a vertical post, a mounting ramp seat that can lower to the ground and function as either a seat or a standing platform, an actuator assembly for lifting motion, a battery unit for power, a wired remote control, rise-assist handles for user support, and dual safety belts for security. The device is capable of lifting individuals weighing up to 300 pounds to a height of 30 inches. It is operated manually via the wired remote and is intended for use by individuals who need assistance in standing or sitting up, such as those with mobility challenges. The unit is self-contained, battery-powered, and comes packaged for retail or direct sale.

title: Valentine Ornaments
facts: These items are decorative ornaments designed for Valentine's Day themes. Each ornament is constructed from galvanized iron, with some including additional materials such as polyester or hemp string for hanging, a wooden bead, or medium density fiberboard (MDF). The first ornament is tag-shaped, measuring 5.25 inches tall by 3.25 inches wide and 0.27 mm thick, and features painted white with small pink hearts, a pink border, and black lettering that reads 'hugs and kisses.' The second ornament is heart-shaped, measuring 6.625 inches tall by 6.25 inches wide and 0.27 mm thick, and displays a red pickup truck with the phrase 'Love is in the Air.' The third ornament resembles a coffee cup with whipped cream and two hearts, measuring 8.25 inches tall by 6.25 inches wide and 0.27 mm thick, and reads 'You and Me' in red lettering. The fourth ornament is diamond-shaped, measuring 7 inches tall by 7 inches wide and 0.27 mm thick, and includes a pink MDF diamond piece with the words 'true LOVE' in white centered on the iron surface. All ornaments are thin, flat decorations intended for hanging display.

title: Mechanical Screw Press Oil Extraction Machinery Line
facts: This is a complete mechanical screw press oil extraction machinery line designed for industrial extraction of fixed vegetable oils from oil-bearing agricultural products such as peanuts, soybeans, sunflower seeds, and cottonseed. The system includes a cooker with integrated heating components, a feed hopper, a rotating screw shaft, a press cage (barrel), a gearbox, a motor assembly, a discharge outlet for the oil cake, and an oil collection system. The machine operates through a mechanical pressing process without chemical solvents, where oil-bearing material from the cooker is conveyed into the press cage by the rotating screw shaft, and increasing mechanical pressure expels oil through openings in the cage. The extracted crude oil is collected, while the residual solid material (oil cake) is discharged separately. All components are shipped together in multiple containers as a single functional unit intended for industrial use.

title: Agricultural Foliar Fertilizers
facts: These are mineral and organomineral liquid fertilizers formulated to supply essential nutrients for plant nutrition and crop development. Each product contains nitrogen, phosphorus, and additional nutrients such as potassium, sulfur, or organic carbon, along with amino acids, functional additives, and other supporting compounds. The fertilizers appear as brown liquids with characteristic odors, have pH values ranging from acidic to alkaline, and are water-soluble. They are supplied in one-liter plastic containers and are intended exclusively for agricultural use as foliar fertilizers, soil applications, or fertigation, without any pesticidal active ingredients or claims.

title: Aminomix
facts: Aminomix is a brown liquid fertilizer formulated to supply nitrogen and phosphorus for plant nutrition and crop development. It contains 3.2% nitrogen (N) and 2.0% phosphorus (PO), along with amino acids, alkalizing agents, and preservatives. The main chemical components are urea (CHNO) and phosphoric acid (HPO). The product has a characteristic odor, a pH less than 5.0, a density of 1.22 g/mL, and is soluble in water. It is intended exclusively for agricultural use as a foliar fertilizer and is supplied in one-liter plastic containers.

title: Herbitec
facts: Herbitec is a green liquid mineral foliar fertilizer formulated to provide nitrogen and potassium for plant nutrition. It is intended exclusively for agricultural plant nutrition purposes and contains no pesticidal active ingredients or pesticidal claims. The product is composed of Potassium Hydroxide and Urea, with a guaranteed analysis of 1.0% Nitrogen (N) and 1.0% Potassium (KO). It has a characteristic odor, a pH greater than 8, a density of 1.00 g/mL, and is soluble in water. Herbitec will be imported in one-liter plastic containers.

title: Disposable CLIC Absorber
facts: These are disposable absorbers designed for use with Dräger anesthesia workstations and compatible respiratory therapy equipment. Each absorber is a sealed plastic cartridge containing a carbon dioxide absorbent material, typically soda lime or an equivalent chemical compound. During anesthesia or respiratory therapy, the patient's exhaled gases pass through the absorber, where the absorbent material chemically removes carbon dioxide from the gas mixture, allowing the remaining gases to be safely recirculated to the patient. The absorber is designed to fit Dräger anesthesia systems using the proprietary CLIC mounting interface. Multiple models (MX0004, MX50004, MX50100, MX50120, MX00001, and MX50050) are available, each with a slightly different shape to work with different machines. The absorbers are supplied individually in sterile packaging for single-use applications in medical settings.

title: CosmeRNA ARI Hair Revitalizing Tonics
facts: The CosmeRNA ARI Intensive Hair Revitalizing Tonic and CosmeRNA ARI SalonPro Hair Revitalizing Tonic are each supplied in sets of ten individual 1 mL ampoules intended for retail sale. The CosmeRNA ARI Hair Revitalizing Tonic is supplied in a single 2 mL pen-type dispenser intended for retail sale. All three products are topical cosmetic preparations formulated for direct application to the scalp. Each product is designed to provide general care for hair and scalp health. The products are manufactured in South Korea and are marketed for personal use in hair maintenance and revitalization.

title: Gift Bows
facts: The goods are decorative gift bows made from a material composed of polyethylene with calcium carbonate as a filler. Three distinct styles are included: the first style has a white background with multicolored dots, the second style features either multicolored stripes or different colored sections, and the third style displays an off-white background with gold leaf patterns. All bows are manufactured through a process that embeds the calcium carbonate into the polyethylene to form a finished decorative item intended for use with wrapped gifts.

title: Olmesartan Medoxomil Tablets
facts: These are Olmesartan Medoxomil tablets provided in three dosage strengths: 5 mg, 20 mg, and 40 mg per tablet. The tablets are manufactured in India and supplied in dosage form for pharmaceutical use. They function as an angiotensin II receptor blocker and are intended for the treatment of hypertension, also known as high blood pressure. The tablets are designed for oral administration by patients to manage blood pressure levels.

title: Ticagrelor Tablets
facts: These are Ticagrelor tablets available in two strengths: 60 mg and 90 mg per tablet. The tablets are manufactured in dosage form for pharmaceutical use. They function as a P2Y12 platelet inhibitor. The intended use is for patients who have experienced a myocardial infarction or are diagnosed with acute coronary syndrome (ACS). The tablets are designed to help prevent future occurrences of myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiovascular death. The product is supplied in packaging suitable for retail or institutional pharmaceutical distribution.

title: Rotary Geared Actuator
facts: The article is a rotary geared actuator, part number 178800-xxx, also called a flap actuator assembly. It features a two-stage gear reduction system designed to operate the leading-edge flaps of Boeing 747 aircraft. The actuator transmits flap drive torque to the linkage system of the leading-edge flaps and is driven by torque from a torque tube. It also transmits rotary motion through the assembly to the next inline actuator and can be used for controlling leading or trailing edge movements of the aircraft. The unit receives power drive unit torque via an assembly of shafts and joints. Mechanically, it functions as an epicyclical gear reducer or compound planetary gearbox, providing a specific gear ratio in a compact form factor. The actuator is purely mechanical, containing no hydraulics, pneumatics, electronics, valve, motor, or position sensor. It is manufactured in the United States and is imported for repair or overhaul from Boeing 747 aircraft operators in Japan, Germany, Luxembourg, Hong Kong, and other countries.

title: Plastic Mandoline Display Unit
facts: The item is a display model of the Precision Slice mandoline, intended for showcase purposes only. It is constructed entirely from plastic with no blades or functional cutting components included. The unit replicates the shape and structure of a typical mandoline slicer but serves purely as a visual representation. It is molded from a single plastic material without any additional layers, coatings, or attached parts. The display unit is static and non-operational, designed for retail or promotional environments to illustrate the design of the mandoline without performing any slicing function. It has no moving parts, power source, or electronic components.

title: Sirius Faucet Aerator
facts: The Sirius faucet aerator is a component designed for attachment to a standard faucet to regulate water flow and improve efficiency. It is constructed entirely from plastics, specifically acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) and polyoxymethylene (POM), with the exception of a stainless steel internal screen washer and a brass threaded connection nut. The device functions by mixing air with water to reduce splash and lower water usage. It is intended for use in residential and commercial plumbing fixtures. The aerator has a standard threaded interface for easy installation and is supplied individually, typically packaged for retail or bulk distribution.

title: Edge-Glued Lumber Panel with HDF and Melamine Overlay
facts: The product is a flat panel measuring approximately 19mm in thickness. It is constructed from edge-glued lumber made of jabon, gmelina, and racuk (padauk), which are tropical woods. Both sides of the panel are overlaid with a 2mm-thick sheet of HDF (high-density fiberboard) and a layer of opaque melamine-impregnated paper. The overlay is applied directly to the edge-glued lumber without any veneer beneath. The panel is supplied as a rigid, flat sheet ready for use in interior finishing applications.

title: Fitness Tablet Consoles
facts: These are tablet consoles designed for integration into exercise equipment such as treadmills or elliptical machines. Each console features a capacitive touchscreen LCD display sized between 16” and 32” depending on the model. They operate on the Android Operating System and function as fully capable tablets. Users can access entertainment, social media, facility communications, and other applications through an App Store while using the equipment. The consoles are permanently installed and not intended to be removed. All models share identical construction and functionality, differing only in screen size to match the host equipment.

title: Pro-fisher metal boat hull
facts: The item is a pro-fisher metal boat hull manufactured by Gospel Boats, constructed entirely from aluminum. It has a total length of 10.3 meters, with a hull length of 9.6 meters, a width of 3 meters, and a depth of 1.66 meters. The hull weighs approximately 3.4 tons and is designed to carry up to 10 people. It features a large enclosed cabin and can be equipped with an independent bathroom and a simple kitchen. The vessel is intended for fishing use and is supplied without motors or electronics, with a recommended motor power range of 300 to 500 horsepower.

title: Multi-Layer Plastic Bag
facts: The article is a plastic bag manufactured in China. It is constructed from a multi-layered laminate sheet composed of oriented polypropylene (OPP), metallized polyethylene terephthalate (PET), and low-density polyethylene (LDPE), with polyethylene making up 80 percent by weight of the bag. The bag measures 6.5 inches in height, 5 inches in width, and 2 inches in depth. It features an integral extruded closure at the top. The bag is designed for use as supplementary packaging.

title: Multi-Layer Plastic Bag
facts: The article is a plastic bag manufactured in Turkey. It is constructed from a multi-layered laminate sheet composed of oriented polypropylene (OPP), metallized polyethylene terephthalate (PET), and low-density polyethylene (LDPE), with polyethylene making up 80 percent by weight of the bag. The bag measures 6.5 inches in height, 5 inches in width, and 2 inches in depth. It features an integral extruded closure at the top and is designed for supplementary packaging purposes.

title: Bumetanide Tablets
facts: These are solid oral dosage form tablets containing the active ingredient bumetanide in concentrations of 1 mg and 2 mg per tablet. The tablets are manufactured in India for pharmaceutical use. They function as loop diuretics and are intended for medical treatment of edema related to conditions such as congestive heart failure, liver disease, kidney disease, and nephrotic syndrome. The tablets are supplied in standard pharmaceutical packaging suitable for retail or institutional distribution.

title: Bumetanide Tablets
facts: These are dosage form tablets containing bumetanide in strengths of 0.5 mg, 1 mg, and 2 mg per tablet. The tablets are manufactured in Spain but exported from India. They function as loop diuretics and are intended for medical use in treating edema related to congestive heart failure, hepatic diseases, renal diseases, and nephrotic syndrome. The product is supplied in pharmaceutical packaging suitable for retail or institutional distribution.

title: Space Dinosaurs Toy Chest
facts: The Space Dinosaurs Toy Chest is a floor-standing storage chest intended for general storage and organization of various items. It is constructed of 100% nonwoven polypropylene textile fabric, made by sewing two layers of this fabric with a 2 mm cardboard insert between them. The chest is collapsible and folds flat when not in use. The lid features a 100% nylon Velcro strip, and there are 100% nonwoven polypropylene textile handles on both the left and right sides. The chest measures approximately 29 inches in length, 14.5 inches in width, and 16 inches in height.

title: Disney Stitch Toy Chest
facts: The Disney Stitch Toy Chest is a floor-standing storage chest intended for general storage and organization of various items. It is constructed of 100% nonwoven polypropylene textile fabric, with two layers of fabric sewn together and a 2 mm cardboard insert placed between them. The chest is collapsible and folds flat when not in use. The lid features a 100% nylon Velcro strip, and there are 100% nonwoven polypropylene textile handles on both the left and right sides. The chest measures approximately 29 inches in length, 14.5 inches in width, and 16 inches in height.

title: Portable Steel Storage Unit
facts: The product is a portable storage unit constructed from 0.8mm-thick galvanized steel. It measures approximately 19 feet in length, 8 feet in width, and 7.5 feet in height. The unit may feature either one set of doors at one end or two sets of doors along the side. It includes forklift slots, rings, and hooks to enable lifting and transport. The unit is designed for outdoor and construction site storage and can also be used to transport household goods. It is shipped flat and assembled after import. The unit is intended to be secured on a flatbed truck for transport.

title: Water Temperature Control Assembly
facts: The item is a water temperature control assembly identified by part number 05048424AD / 54253212. It consists of a thermostat valve with an aluminum housing that includes a piston, spring, frame, rubber component, seal cap, and wax element. The assembly also contains a bypass nipple, a temperature sensor, and a structural junction with coolant bypass passages. When coolant temperature changes, the wax element expands or contracts, which causes the valve to open. Coolant then flows through the passages to the heater and the radiator, preventing the engine from overheating. The assembly is designed for use in automotive cooling systems.

title: Umbrella Stand
facts: The item is a floor-standing furniture stand for storing umbrellas, walking canes, and similar articles. It is constructed entirely from sheet metal. The stand has an oval shape and features two carrying handles for manual transport between locations. Four decorative metal feet are attached to the base. The stand measures approximately 9 inches in length, 7.75 inches in width, and 21.5 inches in height. It does not include wheels or casters. The product is sold as a single unit intended for indoor residential or commercial use.

title: Decorative Animal-Shaped Pillows
facts: These items are decorative pillows shaped like either a dog or a cat, each including a tail. The outer shell is made from 100 percent polyester woven pile fabric and is stuffed with polyester fiberfill. The front features a printed Day of the Dead or calavera design showing a multi-colored skeleton with a skull and bones on a black background. The dog pillow has plastic buttons for eyes, plastic imitation pearls for additional eye details, and a plastic heart-shaped jewel between the eyes; the cat pillow has plastic buttons for eyes. The dog pillow measures 13 inches wide by 4.5 inches deep by 15 inches tall, and the cat pillow measures 13 inches wide by 4.5 inches deep by 16 inches tall. Each pillow is sold individually and is marketed in connection with the Day of the Dead holiday.

title: Colestipol Hydrochloride Tablets
facts: These are tablets made from Colestipol Hydrochloride, each weighing 1 gram. The tablets are supplied in a dosage form intended for oral use. They function as a bile acid sequestrant. The product is designed to be used alongside diet and exercise regimens. The intended users are patients with primary hypercholesterolemia, specifically to help reduce LDL-C cholesterol levels. The tablets are imported from Taiwan.

title: Halloween Costume Accessory Sets
facts: Each set includes multiple textile fabric components designed to be worn for Halloween costumes. The Cat Set features cat ears, a ribbon collar with a bow, and a stuffed tail attached via an elastic loop. The Tiger Set includes tiger ears with a tuft of 'hair,' a ribbon collar with a bow, and a stuffed tail attached with an elastic loop. The Witch Set contains a mini witch hat, a ribbon choker, and textile cuffs. All items are made from textile fabrics and are sold individually on a cardboard header card decorated with skulls and spiders. They are intended for adult wear and are exclusively sold for Halloween, with removal from shelves after the holiday.

title: Silicon Wafer for Equipment Testing
facts: The item is a silicon wafer with the part number 09501-0001-000-00, intended exclusively for testing, qualification, and validation of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. It consists of a bare silicon substrate that may include metal layers such as copper, tin/silver, and nickel/gold to support test structures. The wafer may also contain redistribution layers, pads, or bump structures, which do not perform any electronic function independently. Some documentation references a 'sputter layer' and a layer of a substance called 'Pl' on top of the silicon substrate. The wafer serves as a test vehicle and does not contain any operational electronic circuitry.

title: Artist's Oil and Watercolor Paints in Paste Form
facts: The products are artist's oil and watercolor paints provided in paste form. The oil paints are available in two sizes: 40ml and 225ml, while the watercolor paints are available in a 15ml size. All paint tubes are made of aluminum and feature a squeeze design for easy dispensing. The paints are manufactured entirely in the United Kingdom. They are imported into the United States for commercial resale, intended for distribution through U.S. business-to-business channels to professional artists and art supply retailers.

title: Wooden Trunk
facts: The item is a storage chest constructed from tropical wood. The exterior and lid feature symmetrical metal brass designs and patterns. It includes a front latch locking mechanism, carrying handles on the sides, and metal hinges connecting the lid to the base. The trunk is intended for storing blankets, bedding, clothes, and similar personal items. Its dimensions measure approximately 37 inches in length, 18 inches in width, and 22 inches in height, with a weight of about 106 pounds. The trunk is imported for personal use and will not be sold retail.

title: Autonomous Robotic Tractor
facts: The item is an autonomous robotic tractor identified as the Korechi Pik’r, designed to tow a golf ball collector around golf courses and driving ranges. It operates as a self-navigating, mobile robotic platform capable of independent task execution. The tractor features AI-based navigation, Real Time Kinematic (RTK) positioning for precision, multi-sensor fusion for environmental awareness, and adaptive obstacle avoidance with path planning. It includes an optional automated task execution mechanism for ball dumping. The tractor’s maximum speed is up to 4.8 mph (7.7 kph) and it can cover up to 6.2 acres (2.5 hectares) per hour. The base unit dimensions are 53” x 48” x 32” (1.4m x 1.2m x 0.8m). When configured with a collection system (3 Gang), the overall dimensions are length 133” (3.4m) and height 32” (0.8m).

title: WorkPro Storage Chests and Cabinets
facts: These are wall-mounted steel chests and cabinets designed for storage. They feature compartments for organizing hardware, tools, repair accessories, personal stationery, and small items. Suitable for use in homes, garages, workshops, and similar environments, the units have pre-drilled mounting holes on the back panels for secure attachment to walls, pegboards, or related surfaces. Each unit includes mounting hardware (screws) at the time of importation. Chest dimensions range from 10.83" to 20.47" in length, 5.91" to 14.49" in width, and 5.22" to 12.99" in height. Cabinet dimensions range from 10" to 11.34" in length, 5.98" to 6.38" in width, and 12.03" to 16.57" in height. The products will be offered in multiple paint finishes.

title: Aluminum Canvas Frame with Pin Clip System
facts: The product is a display frame consisting of an aluminum main frame and stainless-steel pin clips. The pin clips attach to the frame and are used to hold and tension canvas fabric, enabling artwork to be shown. Depending on the frame size, the system includes between 10 and 48 pin clips. The canvas fabric itself is not part of the product. The frame and clips are manufactured as a complete kit ready for the user to insert their own canvas material.

title: Bee Pollen Granules
facts: These are raw, unprocessed granules of bee pollen collected directly by bees from flowering plants. The granules are harvested from the hive and undergo a basic cleaning process to remove debris, but remain in their natural granular form without any further processing or mixing with other products. They are packaged in glass jars for retail sale and intended for direct human consumption. The product is sold as a dietary supplement and contains no additives or additional ingredients beyond the naturally occurring components of the bee pollen.

title: Stationary Exercise Bicycle Adapter Assembly
facts: The product is an adapter assembly constructed primarily of aluminum. It consists of a clamp body with an integrated interface post. The rounded clamp mounts securely to a structural member of a stationary exercise bicycle, and the outwardly extending post is designed to receive a standard bicycle stem. Once installed, the assembly mechanically couples the stationary bicycle to a conventional bicycle stem interface, enabling the attachment of aftermarket or standard bicycle handlebars. This allows a rider to replicate the ergonomic reach and grip positioning of an outdoor bicycle during indoor training. The adapter assembly is part of a patent-pending conversion system and is marketed and sold to fitness equipment distributors as well as individual consumers. There may be variation in the geometry, attachment method, interface dimensions, adjustability features, and structural reinforcement of the adapter assembly.

title: Adjustable Face Support Cradle and Cushion Device
facts: The item is a device designed to be placed between a mattress and box spring (or bed frame) to support the head and neck of a user lying prone during massages, relaxation, or therapeutic body treatments. It features a laminated plywood frame with eight adjustable notches to allow for height adjustments and a U-shaped polyurethane (PU) cushion with a PU cover. The cushion is secured to the plywood frame with hook-and-loop tabs. The device measures 11.8 inches in height by 11.2 inches in width, and the U-shaped cushion measures approximately 11.8 inches in width by 3 inches in thickness. The product is imported as a complete, finished product and is ready for use without further assembly. It contains no electronic or mechanical components and does not actively perform massage or therapeutic functions.

title: Dried Coffee Cherry Pericarp
facts: The product is the dried outer layer (pericarp) of the coffee cherry fruit from Coffea arabica and/or Coffea canephora. It is produced either by wet processing, where the outer fruit layer is mechanically removed and sun-dried to 10 to 12 percent moisture, or by dry processing, where whole cherries are sun-dried until the husk separates naturally, also to approximately 10 to 12 percent moisture. The finished product is a single-ingredient dried agricultural byproduct with no additives, preservatives, or processing aids. It is imported in bulk form, unformulated and unpackaged for retail. The product will be used as a raw ingredient in the United States for the production of fermented non-alcoholic beverages and cascara herbal tea infusions, with all further processing and packaging occurring after importation.

title: H-Mod CEP Kit
facts: The H-Mod CEP Kit, identified by SKU # 807-00034-001.A2, is an electrical wiring assembly. It consists of two insulated wires, a printed circuit board assembly, and electrical connectors. This assembly is used in the production of aviation headsets that are installed within aviation helmets. The CEP Kit routes intercom and radio audio signals from the helmet’s internal communication wiring to ear-cup speakers and then to a communication ear plug kit. The ear plug kit contains miniature transducers worn in the pilot’s ear canal. The assembly includes a voltage divider or attenuation network, ensures proper impedance matching, and amplifies the incoming signal from the headset to the in-ear transducers.

title: Bonaterra II Sofa
facts: The Bonaterra II Sofa is a seat constructed with a wooden frame and upholstered in 100% polyester woven fabric. The wooden frame is composed of ½” oriented strand board (OSB) at 41%, bamboo at 31%, ¾” laminated veneer lumber (LVL) at 27%, and medium density fiberboard (MDF) at 1%. It features a heavy-gauge steel spring suspension within the seat foundation frame and includes removable foam seat foundation and seat backrest cushions. The sofa measures 27" in depth, 27" in height, and 89" in length, and comes with a pair of 20" accent pillows. It is designed to provide seating for one or more individuals without any convertibility to a bed or reclining functionality.

title: Women’s Sweatshirt
facts: The item is a women’s upper body garment made from a knit fabric composed of 68 percent cotton and 32 percent polyester, with the inner surface napped. It features a partial front opening that closes with a zipper and includes a self-fabric stand-up collar. The sweatshirt has long sleeves ending in rib knit cuffs with thumb holes, vertical welt pockets on the front panel below the waist, and a 4 ¼-inch-wide rib knit bottom band that tightens the lower edge of the garment.

title: Palsgaard® ChoMilk 150
facts: Palsgaard® ChoMilk 150 is a food additive used in the production of chocolate milk. It consists of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids (E471), a dextrose standardized carrageenan (E407), and guar gum (E412). When added during production, it prevents sedimentation of cocoa particles and fats, improves the texture to give a richer and creamier taste, and reduces excessive foam during processing and filling. It is supplied as a liquid or paste for direct use in food manufacturing processes.

title: Automatic Dicing Saw
facts: The product is an automatic dicing saw, model DAD3231, designed for use in the semiconductor industry. It features a high-speed spindle with a circular diamond blade that rotates up to 60,000 rpm to cut individual integrated circuits (die) from processed silicon wafers. The machine secures the wafer on a vacuum chuck and automatically aligns the cutting path to a precision of 0.001 mm before performing a full-cut through the wafer. It is capable of handling wafers up to 8 inches in diameter and has a Y-axis index positioning accuracy of 0.002/210 mm. The saw is sold as a standalone unit intended for industrial use in semiconductor fabrication facilities.

title: Stainless Steel Rectangular Receptacle
facts: The item is a rectangular container made entirely of stainless steel, measuring 570 mm in length, 431.5 mm in height, and 369 mm at its greatest width. One face has a notch along the bottom edge to allow attachment to a machine, and an opening at the top for receiving discarded items. The container features a beveled upper outer corner when installed. It functions as a static collection bin for discarded or rejected products on conveyor machines, with no moving parts or impact on the machine's operation. The receptacle is supplied as a standalone component and can be used with any compatible machine.

title: Air Conditioning Fittings
facts: These items are fittings for motor vehicle air conditioning systems, consisting of bent aluminum pipes designed to fit specific spaces within a vehicle. Each pipe has attached fittings that interface with air conditioning system components. The aluminum fittings manage the flow of refrigerant between key system parts such as the condenser, compressor, and evaporator. The pipes are pre-formed to precise shapes to match installation requirements in the vehicle. The attached fittings connect to hoses made from various materials and are used exclusively within air conditioning systems. The products are supplied as complete units with the pipes and fittings integrated, ready for installation in motor vehicles.

title: Sea Raider Pirate Costume with Sword
facts: The costume is an adult-size ensemble that includes a long-sleeved pullover top, pull-on pants, boot covers, a belt with buckle, a sash with a skull sword holder, a plastic sword prop, and a head tie. The top is made from a flimsy, man-made knitted textile and features a lace-up front with faux leather strips stitched on using a single line of long, loose straight stitching. It includes grommets and is laced with a flimsy cord that has unfinished ends. The top has a two-piece flat collar stitched together with a single line of long, loose straight stitching. Both the long sleeves and the bottom hem have raw, jagged cut edges with exposed elastic stitched using long, loose straight stitching, giving a tattered appearance. All components are designed to be worn together as a coordinated costume set for theatrical or themed entertainment purposes.

title: Ruby Red Glamour Witch Costume
facts: The costume is a long-sleeved pullover dress made from flimsy man-made knitted textile, featuring a foam collar, long sleeves decorated with capping, and a faux belt in front. The dress has a raw and unfinished hem bottom and is stitched together with a single row of long, loose straight stitching. It includes a conical witch hat and is designed for children, with the sample provided in size 3025-074. The same design will also be sold in adult sizes.

title: Pink Terrazzo Cabinet Pull and Knob
facts: The product consists of cabinet pulls and knobs made from plaster chips mixed with gypsum plaster to create a terrazzo effect. The rectangular cabinet pull has rounded corners and is available in two lengths: 30.5 centimeters or 17.7 centimeters. It measures 2.5 centimeters wide by 3.2 centimeters high at its widest point. The back of each pull includes two threaded metal inserts for mounting. The knob is circular, measuring 4 centimeters in diameter by 3.2 centimeters high at its widest point, and features a single threaded metal insert for mounting on the back. Both items are supplied with mounting hardware.

title: Halfling Messenger Adult Costume
facts: The costume is an adult-sized ensemble that includes a pullover vest, a top, pull-on pants, and a hooded cape. The pullover vest is made from a flimsy, man-made knitted textile and features a V-neck with the hem bottom folded over once and stitched with a single row of long, very loose straight stitching. The vest’s armholes are raw and unfinished, and it has five non-functional buttons stitched down the front. All components of the costume are stitched together using a single line of long, loose straight stitches.

title: Adult Dark Crusader and Crusader Costume Set
facts: The costume set includes a long-sleeved, knee-length pullover robe referred to as a tunic, a cape, cuffs, a sash belt, a helmet mask, and a sword/shield (not included in the sample). The robe is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features large, loose overlock stitching on the neck and long sleeves. The foam shoulder armor has raw, unfinished edges. The robe includes two front slits that are raw and unfinished, along with a raw, jagged cut hem bottom, creating a tattered appearance. The robe is stitched together using a single line of long, loose, straight stitching. The costume is available in adult sizes, with specific items numbered 5127-015 (Dark Crusader, black) and 5127-016 (Crusader, white).

title: Decorative Artificial Wreath
facts: The item is a decorative artificial wreath identified as “ARTIF WRTH 22IN PINK,” with the item number DB1-RSMRA016A. The wreath measures 22 inches in diameter. It features pink flowers made from 100 percent polyester fabric attached to molded plastic stems. The base of the wreath is constructed from toad vine, though this material is mostly obscured. The components are bound together using paper tape to assemble the finished wreath.

title: Nativity Joseph Costume
facts: The costume is a child-size ensemble that includes a long-sleeved pullover robe and a headpiece. The robe is constructed from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features large, visible overlock stitching at the neck and raw edges on the sleeves and bottom hem. It is assembled using a single line of long, loose straight stitching. The same design will also be produced and sold in adult sizes.

title: Melchior, Wise Man Costume
facts: This costume is a child-size ensemble that includes a long-sleeved robe, a short cape, and a crown headpiece. The robe is made from a flimsy, man-made knitted textile and features a two-piece collar with a deep back opening. The back opening is closed with a single small patch of hook and loop fastener and has large, visible, loose overlock stitching. The long sleeves and hem bottom of the robe are raw and unfinished, giving the robe a shapeless, floor-length appearance. The costume is not well-made. It will also be offered in adult sizes under a different item number.

title: Child Size Costume Gaspar
facts: The costume is a child size ensemble identified as Gaspar, Wise Man item number 3126-105. It consists of a long-sleeved pullover robe, a short cape, and a turban headpiece. The robe is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features large visible, loose overlock stitching on the deep back opening, which is closed with a single small tab of hook and loop fastener. The neck of the robe has a raw edge folded over once and sewn with a single line of long, very loose straight stitching. Both the long sleeves and the hem bottom of the shapeless robe are raw and unfinished. The same design will also be produced and sold in adult sizes under item number 5126-108.

title: Nefertiti/Nefertiri Costume Set
facts: This costume set includes a full-length, sleeveless pullover dress, a sash belt, armbands, cuffs, and a headpiece, all in child size. The dress is made from a man-made knitted textile and features large, loose overlock stitching around the armholes. The neck area has some capping and a deep back opening with raw, unfinished edges, closed by a single small tab with hook and loop fastener. The dress has a shapeless design with a raw, unfinished hem. All components are presented together as a coordinated set intended for retail sale.

title: Disco Dolly Adult Costume
facts: The costume is an adult-sized ensemble that includes a long-sleeved dress and a head wrap. The dress is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile. It features a raw edge at the neck that is folded over once and stitched with a single line of long, loose straight stitching. Both the long sleeves and the bottom hem of the dress are raw and unfinished. The dress sections are assembled using a single line of long, loose straight stitching. The costume is intended for wear as a themed outfit by adults and is sold as a complete set in its packaging.

title: Balthasar Wise Man Costume
facts: This costume is a child-size sample that includes a long-sleeved pullover robe with an attached cape and a separate turban headpiece. The robe and cape are made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and feature large, loose overlock stitching along the neck, back opening, and edges. The deep back opening is closed with a single small tab of hook and loop fastener. Foam shoulder pads are incorporated into the design. The attached cape, sleeves, and bottom hem are raw and unfinished. The costume will also be produced in adult sizes.

title: WorkPro Tool Storage System
facts: The WorkPro Tool Storage System is a three-tier stackable unit consisting of two chests and one cabinet constructed from steel. The top chest has two rows of drawers, the middle chest has three rows of drawers, and the bottom cabinet has two doors. All components feature compartments for organizing and storing hardware, tools, repair accessories, and small items. The product is designed for compact spaces and is ideal for home use in areas such as studies, bedrooms, and personal storage areas. The unit is offered for retail sale either as a complete set or as individually packed components. The top chest measures approximately 11 inches in width, 6 inches in depth, and 6 inches in height; the middle chest measures approximately 11 inches in width, 6 inches in depth, and 7 inches in height; and the bottom cabinet measures approximately 11 inches in width, 6 inches in depth, and 12 inches in height.

title: Mini Valentine Plush
facts: These are heart-shaped textile plush home decorations intended for the Valentine season. Each decoration is made from 100 percent polyester knitted dyed pile fabric and is stuffed with 100 percent polypropylene filling. The decorations measure 5 inches in length, 4 inches in width, and 1 inch in depth. Six color and message variations exist: purple with “CUTIE PIE,” light pink with “XOXO,” blue with “BESTIE,” red with “LOVE,” hot pink with “BE MINE,” and yellow with “SWEETHEART.” The style number is indicated by the fabric color and embroidered message on the top surface.

title: Plastic Alphabet Charms
facts: The product consists of molded plastic pieces shaped as the letters of the alphabet. Each charm features a loop on top for stringing. The charms are produced in various colors and sold in assorted letter groupings. They are supplied for use in home craft projects. No additional components or power sources are required. Packaging typically contains multiple charms in a single unit for retail or bulk distribution.

title: Women’s Sleeveless Knit Top with Built-In Shelf Bra
facts: This is a women’s sleeveless upper body garment made from a knit fabric composed of 56 percent lyocell, 37 percent viscose (rayon), and 7 percent spandex. The garment features a built-in shelf bra securely sewn into the neckline, shoulders, and underarms. It has a scoop front neckline, a racerback design, and oversized armholes. Shoulder straps measure approximately 1.75 inches in width, with capping at the neckline and armholes. The bottom edge is hemmed and finished with lace trim.

title: Hardcover Book
facts: The item is a hardcover book titled 'If Lost Start Here.' It contains 200 pages and measures approximately 21.8 cm by 15.5 cm by 2.2 cm. The book introduces ten fundamental approaches to wellbeing and discusses the science and benefits of each approach. Some pages include reflective prompts, self-coaching exercises, challenges, and activities intended to help readers engage with the material, track their progress, and build a personalized wellbeing toolkit. The book is designed for general readers seeking wellbeing guidance.

title: Hardcover Books
facts: The goods are four hardcover books titled 'Dear Mom, You’re the Best,' 'Dear Dad, You’re the Best,' 'Dear Grandma, You’re the Best,' and 'Dear Grandpa, You’re the Best.' Each book has 32 pages and measures approximately 17 cm by 17 cm by 1 cm. The interior pages include decorative designs and illustrations. Some pages contain inspirational statements, while others have lined sections with guided prompts for writing personal responses, memories, or reflections. The books are printed on paper and bound in a hardcover format.

title: Women’s Blouse
facts: The item is a women’s blouse made from a velour knit fabric composed of 95 percent polyester and 5 percent spandex. The fabric measures 15 stitches per linear centimeter horizontally and 20 stitches per linear centimeter vertically. The blouse has a loose fit with a round neckline, long raglan sleeves ending in elasticized cuffs, and an elasticized bottom band that does not tighten the waist or hips. It is designed as a lightweight, casual top intended for women and is not constructed to be worn over other clothing for weather protection.

title: Scent Crusher Locker Kit
facts: The product is a floor-standing storage locker kit made from a steel metal frame with adjustable wire mesh shelving components and polyester textile fabric zipper enclosures. Each kit includes a battery-operated ozone generator unit composed of a Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA), ceramic corona plate, and rechargeable battery housed in a plastic enclosure. The ozone generator draws in air, passes it through a corona plate to create ozone, which sterilizes and removes odors. The Scent Crusher Locker measures approximately 45 inches in width, 69 inches in height, and 27 inches in depth, while the Scent Crusher Locker Lite measures approximately 28 inches in width, 69 inches in height, and 20 inches in depth. The kits are designed for storing and organizing hunting gear, sports equipment, and athletic gear, and are suitable for direct sale to end users without repacking.

title: Woman’s Skort
facts: The garment is a woman’s skort made entirely from 100% cotton woven fabric. It combines a skirt permanently attached to an under short. The short portion features hemmed leg openings for a clean finish. The skirt portion includes a flat front waistband with a partially elasticized waist for flexibility and comfort. It has front slanted side pockets for functionality and a stylishly curved back rear patch detail. The bottom of the skirt is hemmed, and the overall design extends from the waist to the mid-thigh area.

title: Automotive Timing Chain Guide Assembly
facts: The item is a timing chain guide assembly, part number 24430-2J000, designed for use in the NU PE engine. It is a component of the timing chain system that links the crankshaft and the camshaft, synchronizing the reciprocating motion of the pistons with the opening and closing of the intake and exhaust valves. The assembly guides the timing chain between the crank sprocket and the cam sprocket, ensuring the chain follows a constant path. During high-speed engine operation, it restrains the timing chain against displacement caused by centrifugal force and vibration, maintaining precise engagement with the sprockets. The component is manufactured from durable engineering plastics and/or metal alloys suitable for high-temperature and high-stress engine environments. It is supplied individually in commercial packaging for automotive repair and maintenance use.

title: Timing Chain Tensioning Assemblies
facts: These are timing chain tensioner assemblies, specifically part numbers 24410-2S001 and 24410-2S300, designed for use in the Hyundai THETA-III Engine. They function as components of a timing chain system that synchronizes the crankshaft and camshaft, ensuring precise piston movement coordination with intake and exhaust valves. Installed on the non-driven side of the timing chain, they maintain proper chain tension and prevent slack. Each assembly includes a cam mechanism that controls plunger position and limits reverse movement, supported by spring force and hydraulic pressure. During operation, they respond to fluctuating chain tension by adjusting plunger position, absorbing shock through hydraulic damping, and thereby minimizing friction and wear on related components. These assemblies are critical for engine timing accuracy and longevity.

title: Hydro Dip Mini Pumpkin Kit
facts: The kit contains four water-soluble hydro dip sheets made from polyvinyl alcohol (PVA), each measuring five inches by five inches. It includes five alcohol-based markers in blue, purple, red, black, and green. The kit also has two Halloween-themed patterns printed on paper and two mini binder clips. An instruction set is included. All components are packaged together in a retail box. The user attaches a hydro dip sheet to a pattern with the binder clips, fills in the design with the markers, then dips a mini pumpkin through the film on a water surface to transfer the pattern onto the pumpkin.

title: Leveler Nut Assembly
facts: The item is a leveler nut assembly, part number W11803498, composed of a steel nut threaded onto a specially designed steel bolt with a sticky circular head. This assembly attaches to the bottom of a refrigerator-freezer unit to prevent movement and enable height adjustment, ensuring the appliance remains level and the refrigerator door seals correctly. The components are made entirely of steel and are manufactured through machining and threading processes. The assembly is sold individually, intended exclusively for use in refrigerator-freezer appliances, and is delivered in protective packaging suitable for direct installation.

title: Flexible Gas Supply Tube
facts: The item is a flexible tube, Model # EFGC-034-BJ-1414-72, intended to connect a gas supply for food service utilities such as cooking ranges and ovens. The interior consists of a flexible corrugated stainless steel tube wrapped with a stainless steel braid. The exterior is covered with a protective layer of polyvinyl chloride (PVC), providing flexibility. The tube includes an adapter and bushing assembly on each end to secure it in place and function as fittings.

title: Men’s Upper Body Garment
facts: This is a men’s upper body garment made entirely from 100 percent polyester knit fabric. The outer surface of the fabric is heavily napped, while the inner surface is lightly napped. The fabric has more than nine stitches per two centimeters in the direction the stitches were formed. The garment features a full front opening closed with a zipper that extends through a woven fabric stand-up collar. It has long sleeves finished with contrasting knit fabric capping at the ends. There is a woven fabric overlay on the upper left front panel, a woven patch pocket with a zippered closure on the right chest, and two vertical pockets with zippered closures below the waist. The bottom of the front panels is straight and loose-fitting, finished with contrasting knit fabric capping.

title: DIY Canvas Painting Kit
facts: The product is a do-it-yourself canvas painting kit intended for children ages three and above. The kit contains six acrylic paint pods in assorted colors, one paintbrush, one small canvas with a pre-outlined image, one small plastic easel, and one sheet of stickers. All components are designed to be used together for the purpose of creatively painting and decorating the canvas. The kit is supplied in a condition suitable for retail sale, packaged for direct sale to end users without the need for re-packing. The components function together to allow users to complete a painting activity.

title: Compact Dental Milling Machine and Subassemblies
facts: The item is a compact milling machine designed for dental professionals to create custom dental prostheses for individual patients. The machine is constructed from several sub-assemblies mounted on a base frame and enclosed by protective plastic panels. It includes a central precision assembly for dental milling supported by various performance and reliability systems. Key subassemblies are the F2 XYZ Mech Assembly, which houses linear motion and automation components for precise dental milling using a 4-axis cartesian mechanism with six high-precision linear rails, three ball screws, three servo motors, a stepper motor, and structural components. The F2 Right Cover Assembly attaches to the right side, featuring a door control button, safety guarding for moving components, and necessary PCB and cabling. The F2 Back Cover Assembly attaches to the back with foam cushions to manage airflow and cool electrical components. The F2 Manifold Assembly directs air and coolant flow within the machine, consisting of a manifold, fittings, and a proximity sensor to detect coolant trough insertion. All subassemblies function solely within the milling system and have no independent use outside of it.

title: Compact Dental Milling Machine Subassemblies
facts: These items include the F2 Door Assembly, a plastic door with a viewing window mounted to a multi-piece sheet metal frame for enclosing the cutting area and aligning during assembly. The F2 Coolant Trough Assembly is a reservoir made from four injection-molded plastic components and one sheet metal part, featuring baskets with mesh screens to filter coolant and a metal flag for proper insertion detection. The F2 Coolant Intake Assembly monitors coolant levels and draws coolant, consisting of sheet metal, plastic injection, and other components with a linkage system connecting to the coolant trough drawer. The F2 Basin Assembly contains the basin where the spindle interacts with dental material, includes a sheet metal housing, seals to contain coolant, and belts and pulleys for operating the basin door.

title: Compact Dental Milling Machine Subassemblies
facts: These are subassemblies for a compact dental milling machine. The F2 Base Support Assembly forms the base structure and holds a drawer for a coolant trough and flow meter, featuring a plastic divider, drawer slides, a grab latch, fasteners, machined parts, sheet metal, and plastic components. The F2 Base Divider Assembly bolts into the machine base, separating the lower half into compartments for pumps and electrical components, and includes an air filter, air pressure sensor, and tubing provisions for the sealing air system. Both subassemblies are exclusively used for the operation, control, or mechanical functioning of the dental milling machine and have no independent function outside the milling system.

title: Julia and Emi’s Hawaiian Fishy Friends
facts: This is a hardcover board book with 24 illustrated pages containing text. The book measures approximately 7.87” x 7.87”. It follows two sisters, Julia and Emi, on an underwater adventure in Hawaii. Each spread includes text describing facts about the appearance, behavior, and unique characteristics of reef fish, along with an illustration of the fish labeled with its common and Hawaiian name. The content also covers topics of ocean safety and the importance of caring for the marine environment. The book is intended for children.

title: Steel Mobile Workstation
facts: The Steel Mobile Workstation is a fully assembled unit consisting of a steel chassis frame supporting three unequipped locking steel garage storage cabinets arranged in a row. The left and right cabinets each measure 15.6 inches in width, while the middle cabinet measures 34.7 inches in width. A horizontal rubberwood tabletop worksurface, measuring 72 inches in width, 19.1 inches in depth, and 1.4 inches in height, sits atop the cabinet base. A vertical pegboard surface, 72 inches wide and 18.1 inches high, is integrated into the design. An overhead storage hutch containing three locking cabinets completes the unit. The complete assembled dimensions are approximately 79 inches wide, 19 inches deep, and 73 inches high. The unit is delivered ready for the end user to attach wheel casters for mobility.

title: Multi-Purpose Gloves
facts: These gloves are made from 100% polyester knit fabric with a thermoplastic polyurethane membrane sandwiched between layers. They feature fourchettes and elastic at the wrist opening. Two versions exist: one plain and one with coated plastic knit overlays on the palm side of the index finger and thumb, plus silicon plastic gripping designs on the palm. Both versions come in two colors, black and white, and seven sizes from XXS to XXL. The gloves are designed for multi-purpose use and contain over 50% textile material by weight.

title: Steel TV Wall Mount Bracket
facts: The article is a wall-mounted bracket designed to hold a flat-panel television on a wall or similar vertical surface. It is constructed entirely from steel with no aluminum components. This full-motion mount supports television screen sizes from 13 to 77 inches. The bracket includes necessary mounting hardware for installation. The product enables adjustable positioning of the TV and is intended for household or commercial use to display screens securely on walls.

title: Women’s Casual Flat Shoe
facts: This is a woman’s casual flat shoe that does not cover the ankle. The external surface of the upper (esau) is composed of more than ninety percent rubber or plastics, with a long, thin, elastic lace making up less than ten percent of the esau. The lace is threaded through eight pairs of metal eyelets on the sides of the vamp opening and is intended to be wrapped and tied around the lower half of the leg. The outer sole is made entirely of rubber or plastics. The shoe does not include a foxing or foxing-like band.

title: Steel Liquid Containment Barriers
facts: These are devices made of steel to stop liquids from spreading through openings like doorways in industrial places. Each barrier has a moving flap, strong side posts, seals, a floor housing, and a way to close by itself. It sits level with the floor, either in front of or inside an opening where liquids might leak. When liquid touches it, the flap moves up by itself—no electricity, sensors, or outside power needed. The barrier works on its own, using the weight of the liquid to lift the flap into a vertical position, blocking the flow without any extra parts or machines.

title: LiteBar
facts: The LiteBar is a fiberglass-reinforced plastic (FRP) rebar. It is designed to be used as a substitute for traditional steel rebar in concrete reinforcement applications. The product is made from a composite material that includes fiberglass reinforcement within a plastic matrix. It is supplied in linear lengths suitable for construction use. Images of the product were provided for identification purposes. The rebar is intended for use in the construction industry to reinforce concrete structures.

title: Neoracer Autonomous Racecar
facts: The Neoracer is a 1:12 scale model of a Formula 1 racecar, constructed from durable plastic and metal components. It features a brushed motor and a 4-wheel-drive drivetrain for propulsion. The vehicle includes a LiDar and camera module for sensing its environment. Mounted on top is an AI compute board with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano module, containing a graphics processing unit (GPU), central processing unit (CPU) cores, a fan, and multiple connection points for external devices. This racecar is powered by an external computer, where users employ programming languages such as Python to instruct the vehicle to navigate autonomously on surfaces such as racetracks. It is intended for use by universities, educational institutions, AI researchers, and advanced hobbyists to study and develop autonomous programming skills. The racecar measures approximately 280 mm in length, 120 mm in width, and 80 mm in height, and is typically sold in retail packaging designed for individual use or educational kits.

title: Round Tabletop
facts: The Round Tabletop is a table furniture component measuring 60 inches in diameter and 2 inches thick, weighing 108 pounds. It consists of a plywood core underlayment and a copper-clad sheet metal surface that is 1 mm thick and covers the entire diameter of the tabletop. The copper-clad sheet metal surface is attached to the plywood core, which provides structural integrity and prevents flexing or deflection when items are placed on the surface. After importation into the United States, this component will be mounted to table legs, a table pedestal, or a table base foundation to complete the table. The materials and components are adapted to each other, forming a unitary whole designed for functional use as part of a table.

title: Polypropylene Record Sleeves
facts: These are protective outer sleeves made from polypropylene plastic, designed specifically for vinyl record jackets. Their purpose is to store, protect, and preserve vinyl records and their outer jackets during storage, handling, display, and transport. The sleeves shield record jackets from dust, scratches, moisture, fingerprints, handling marks, and general wear. They are sold in retail packaging as a pack of 100 sleeves.

title: Electric Heating Pad
facts: The product is an electric heating pad designed to be worn over the shoulders, neck, and back to provide heat therapy for muscle relaxation and warmth. It consists of four layers: a top and bottom outer shell made from 100 percent polyester knitted plush fabric, a second layer of 100 percent polyester nonwoven needle-punched fabric, and a third layer of 100 percent polyester nonwoven needle-punched fabric bonded to heating wire. When laid flat, the pad measures 26 inches in width and 34 inches in length, and when worn, it contours to 23 inches across the shoulders and 28 inches in height. The pad features two sets of snap buttons in the center front for securing around the shoulders and a 1 ½ inch wide by 23-inch-long self-fabric strap tied across the abdomen for additional fit. Glass beads are partially incorporated along the edges of the collar and bottom edge to keep the pad in place. It includes a detachable handheld controller offering ten temperature settings and three timer options (one to three hours), with a two-hour auto-off safety default.

title: Wiha Model #35393 Allen Key Set
facts: This product is a set of five Allen keys, also known as hex keys or Allen wrenches, made from steel. Each key is constructed from a hexagonal steel rod bent into a 90-degree 'L' shape. The set includes keys of various sizes to accommodate different hexagonal socket heads on bolts or screws. These tools are hand-operated and function by applying torque to the hexagonal socket of a fastener, with the force exerted perpendicular to the fastener's axis. The keys are packaged for retail sale, presented as a complete set in one package.

title: Express
facts: The Express is a walk-through style concealed weapons detection system designed for quick, non-invasive screening of people in locations such as stadiums, schools, hospitals, and event venues. It features a center transmitting tower with one or two receiving towers forming single-lane or dual-lane walk-through paths. The system includes floor stand- and desktop stand-mounted pre-programmed tablets, floor mats covering interconnecting cables, integrated cameras, and modem/router hardware for connectivity. Embedded proprietary software with AI-based security analysis enables on-site, edge computing without requiring an internet connection. Using advanced sensors, the Express evaluates magnetic signatures to distinguish between common metallic objects and potential weapons, providing alerts through flashing red LED lights, audible signals, and a visual threat indicator on the tablet display that pinpoints the location of any detected dangerous item.

title: LED Bow Decoration
facts: The item is an LED Bow Decoration with item number 1851620. It consists of a three-dimensional iron wire frame shaped like a bow, covered with two layers of polyester mesh fabric. White and red LED lights are attached to the perimeter of the body and tails of the bow using zip ties. The bow measures 48 inches by 48 inches and includes two tails of ribbon measuring 23 inches and 35.5 inches. An adapter, power cord, screws, and two sturdy 2-inch hanging loops are included with the bow. The product is marketed for the holiday season and is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The LED lights are intended to enhance the decorative effect of the bow, with any illumination of the surrounding space being incidental to its decorative purpose.

title: Floss Pick
facts: The article is a floss pick composed of a flat piece of stainless steel. It features a finger grip on one end and two suspension prongs on the opposite end. A round knob is positioned between the prongs to tie and secure a piece of dental floss, allowing it to function as a lever for flossing teeth. The floss itself is not made of metal and is separate from the stainless steel structure. The device is designed for personal dental hygiene use, typically by individuals performing flossing as part of their oral care routine. It is supplied as a single unit, ready for immediate use after the floss is attached.

title: Harvest Fabric Bow Tie Decoration
facts: The item is a single-sided wall or door hanging decoration measuring approximately 12 inches long by 2 inches wide by 16 inches high. It features a design resembling a bow with long tails and includes a permanently attached cutout leaf design at the knot of the stuffed textile bow. The decoration displays the printed greeting 'Happy Thanksgiving.' A jute loop is incorporated for hanging the decoration on a wall or door. The entire bow is stuffed and intended for decorative use only, and it is not wearable as a necktie.

title: Structural Timber Frame Kit
facts: This kit allows construction of a permanent outdoor gazebo without walls. It contains multiple structural members made from Douglas fir wood, each shaped using mortise and tenon joinery. The kit also includes oak pegs for assembly, steel hardware and connectors, and engineered assembly plans. The materials are exclusively structural wood members—no dimensional lumber is provided. The components are designed to form posts, trusses, and a roof once assembled.

title: Rechargeable USB Fan
facts: The product is a portable fan identified as model 1PAFFLEXR. It measures 6 inches in diameter and has a circular shape. The fan includes a power button and indicators that show charging status and fan speed. It features a built-in hook for hanging and three flexible legs that allow it to stand on flat surfaces or attach to objects such as stroller handles, chairs, or car seats. The fan is powered by a rechargeable battery and can be charged via USB.

title: IHT Spirit Heart Rate Monitor
facts: The IHT Spirit Heart Rate Monitor is a wrist-worn, battery-powered wearable device designed to monitor and track physical effort. It features a secure, multi-component plastic housing with a top cover, bottom cover, sealing rubber gasket, and an adjustable wrist strap, all enclosed in an IP-rated waterproof casing for active use. Internally, it contains a Main Board with a Microcontroller Unit (MCU), control circuitry, a rechargeable battery, and a digital display screen. The device includes an optical heart rate sensing module that uses photoplethysmography (PPG) technology, emitting light through a lens into the user’s skin and capturing backscattered light to measure blood changes. It displays real-time metrics such as heart rate, heart rate zone status, min/max heart rate, time in active zones, activity goal progress, date/time, and battery status. Data is transmitted wirelessly via an integrated Bluetooth module to a compatible host smart device running proprietary software for activation, data logging, and reporting. The unit does not support cellular or smartphone notifications like calls, emails, or text alerts.

title: Yukan One Ingredient Pizza Crust
facts: The product is a thin, circular flatbread made entirely from 100 percent cassava (manioc) root. It is produced by washing, peeling, grating, and pressing fresh cassava roots, then forming the mixture into circular shapes and baking until fully cooked and dried. Each flatbread measures approximately 10 inches (25.4 centimeters) in diameter. The product is sold in retail packaging containing ten flatbreads with a net weight of 850 grams (1.8 pounds). It is shelf-stable and ready for consumption, intended for use as a base for gluten-free pizza preparations, bread alternatives, and meal accompaniments. No additional ingredients, preservatives, additives, or processing aids are used during manufacturing.

title: Agricultural Sprayers and Floaters
facts: These are self-propelled machines engineered for applying fertilizers, chemicals, pesticides, herbicides, manure, and other agricultural materials to farmland. The sprayers are built for flat or gently sloped terrain and include large-capacity liquid tanks, high-clearance booms, and integrated pumping and application systems for efficient field coverage. Floaters are designed for uneven, soft, or difficult terrain with raised chassis systems, wide wheels or tracks for flotation and stability, and capabilities for liquid, granular, or combined applications. The Case Titan Floater 4040 and 4540 each have an 1800-gallon tank, 340 rated horsepower, a rear-mounted boom, and measure 3.7 meters wide by 72 to 90 feet long. The Case Patriot 3250 has an 800 or 1000-gallon tank, 285 rated horsepower, a speed range of 0 to 32 MPH, and a rear-mounted boom with multiple width options from 60 to 135 feet. The New Holland Guardian SP370F has a tank size of 1200, 1400, or 1600 gallons, 328 rated horsepower, a top speed of 19.88 MPH, and features front-mounted booms available in mono, truss, and spray-air configurations with various width options.

title: Pressure Tanks for Water Pumping Systems
facts: These are pressure tanks designed for use in water pumping systems, compatible with jet pumps, booster pumps, centrifugal pumps, and submersible pumps. The specific models include PWN-US-80LV, PWN-US-18LX, PWN-US-80LH, and SFN-US-325LV, with capacities ranging from 4.8 gallons to 85.9 gallons. Each tank features a carbon steel exterior and contains two internal chambers: a water chamber and an air chamber pre-charged with pressurized air. The chambers are separated by a flexible butyl rubber membrane, also known as a diaphragm or bladder. Fixed diaphragm models in the PWN series additionally include a polypropylene liner. All tanks are equipped with water connection fittings, air valves, and an integrated support base. During operation, the tank is factory-pre-charged with air pressure to form an internal air cushion; when the pump runs, water enters and compresses the air, building pressure until the pump shuts off, then the compressed air pushes water out as needed, and the cycle repeats when pressure drops.

title: Women’s Closed-Toe Work Boot Upper
facts: This is a woman’s closed-toe, closed-heel work boot upper made from sewn-together leather pieces. The shaft extends above the ankle and features five pairs of metal eyelets over the forefoot and four pairs of metal hooks for a lace closure. It is fully shaped and sewn to a midsole, with a circular hole larger than a nickel punched through the heel area of the upper’s bottom. After importation, the boot upper will undergo further processing including plugging the hole, inserting a fiberboard heel tuck, nailing on a rubber heel, trimming excess materials, cleaning, inserting the footbed, and inserting a lace. The completed shoe will then be packed into a shoe box for retail sale.

title: Women’s Blouses
facts: These are women’s upper body garments made from a knit fabric composed of 84 percent modal, 9 percent cashmere, and 7 percent elastane. The fabric surface has more than 10 stitches per linear centimeter in both horizontal and vertical directions. The garments are loose-fitting and extend from the shoulders to below the waist. One style has a round front neckline with short, hemmed sleeves, while the other style has a round front neckline with long, hemmed sleeves, both with a straight, hemmed bottom. They are designed for general wear, suitable for both home comfort and casual outings.

title: Woman's Undergarment Style 948313
facts: This is a woman's undergarment made from a knit mesh fabric that is 98% nylon and 2% elastane. The garment includes a 100% cotton crotch lining, an exposed elastic waistband, and elasticized leg openings with decorative trim. It features leg extensions and is designed to be worn as a undergarment. The product is imported from Indonesia and is presented for retail sale in its standard packaging.

title: Aquarium Sea Salt Synthetic Preparation
facts: This product is a synthetic reef aquarium salt compound designed for use in saltwater aquariums.
