It is composed of food-grade sodium chloride, anhydrous sodium sulfate, anhydrous magnesium sulfate, magnesium chloride hexahydrate, potassium chloride, calcium chloride dihydrate, and other trace compounds. The mixture is manufactured to replicate natural seawater conditions for marine life in aquariums. It is supplied in powdered form, intended to be dissolved in water to create a balanced saltwater environment. The product is packaged in sealed containers suitable for retail or direct-to-business distribution.

title: Wall Mounted Iron Hanging Sign Brackets
facts: These are L-shaped brackets made from 1/8” cut steel sheet. Each bracket has two predrilled holes on the wall-mounting side. A ½” square iron bar runs lengthwise with a cast iron ornamental tip. A steel flat bar with decorative steel curls sits diagonally inside the L shape. Two small steel flat bar hangers, each with a predrilled hole, extend from the square bar to hold a hanging sign. The brackets come in two sizes: 10” x 24” and 8” x 14”. They are designed for permanent vertical attachment to a wall or flat surface to support the weight of a hanging sign.

title: Coated Paperboard Decorative House Model
facts: The item is a decorative model of a house or church constructed entirely from coated paperboard. It includes two trees placed in a yard area and is surrounded by a picket fence made of the same material. An internal light source is present inside the house structure but does not function to illuminate an external space. The model is designed for tabletop display and is typically sold during the Christmas season, though it contains no Christmas-specific symbols or motifs. It is intended as a seasonal decorative centerpiece with no specified dimensions or weight provided.

title: SHERP N1200 Amphibious Off-Road Vehicle
facts: The SHERP N1200 is an amphibious off-road vehicle designed for commercial, industrial, agricultural, environmental, and scientific operations. It is commonly used to transport personnel, tools, materials, and supplies across challenging terrain including swamps, muskeg, marshes, snow, ice, sand, flood conditions, and open water. The vehicle is powered by a 1.8 liter, 3-cylinder diesel engine producing 55 horsepower. It features standard 2-passenger seating and has a payload capacity of 2,640 lb (1.1 metric tons). The vehicle also has a towing capacity of 5,170 lbs. Its amphibious capability allows it to transition between land and water, but its principal function remains the transport of goods across difficult terrain inaccessible to conventional wheeled vehicles.

title: Stone Paper Corrugated Boxes
facts: These are corrugated boxes made from a composite material consisting of 70 to 80 percent by weight calcium carbonate and 20 to 30 percent by weight polyethylene. The boxes are manufactured through a process that combines these materials to form a rigid, flat sheet which is then corrugated to create the final box shape. They are designed specifically for packaging and shipping various goods. The boxes are sold in their finished form, ready for use in packaging, and are typically used by businesses to protect and transport products during shipment.

title: Molded Plastic Tool Case
facts: The article is a molded plastic case designed to function as a tool case, structured and rigid on all sides. It resembles a briefcase or attaché case in form. The interior includes a foam insert that is not specially shaped or fitted for any specific item. The case is intended for storing, protecting, organizing, and transporting its contents. It is made from plastic through a molding process. The case is sold individually, typically packaged for retail or commercial distribution, and is suitable for general use by professionals or individuals requiring portable storage solutions.

title: Laminated Textile Fabric for Protective Clothing
facts: The product is a three-layer laminated textile fabric imported in a finished state from France. The outer layer is a woven face fabric composed entirely of man-made fibers. The middle layer is a flame-resistant polyurethane membrane, and the inner layer is a polyurethane adhesive. Plastic materials constitute approximately 32 percent of the total weight of the fabric. The overall fabric weight is 155 grams per square meter. The material functions as a moisture barrier or outer shell layer intended for use in protective clothing specifically designed for firefighters.

title: Sigma Shaped Nonalloy Steel Posts
facts: These are sigma shaped, nonalloy steel posts that are zinc coated. They are cold-rolled and have holes drilled along their length. Each post measures between 150 - 180 mm in height, 80 - 100 mm in width, and 4.1 - 5.3 meters in length. They are made from steel and are intended for use in utility-scale solar farms. The posts are supplied in a packaged form suitable for structural installation in solar energy infrastructure.

title: Floating Hull Protectors
facts: These are floating structures meant to reduce marine growth on submerged hull surfaces by limiting water contact and movement. During use, they are placed on the water’s surface and secured to a marina berth with mooring lines. A vessel is guided onto the protector’s upper surface where it stays stationary. Standing water is routed away from the hull and outer bumpers stop more water from entering the area. The protectors are made of reinforced marine-grade polyvinyl chloride (PVC), buoyant closed-cell foam, and laminated low-density polyethylene (LDPE) bubble material. They are imported fully assembled and ready to use in five sizes: extra small, small, medium, large, and extra large. All models share the same construction, materials, and primary use. The protectors are not attached to or part of a vessel, nor do they function as a dock, pier, or fixed marine structure.

title: Plastic Cartridge for Additive Manufacturing
facts: The article is a molded plastic cartridge consisting of two parts: a hollow cylindrical barrel with a capacity of 100 milliliters and a fitted plunger that slides within the barrel. The barrel is constructed from plastic, while the plunger is also made of plastic and features a rubber tip. The cartridge functions as a material reservoir and dispensing unit in an additive-manufacturing (3D printing) system, where it is filled with a printing paste and mounted in the printer. A mechanical drive advances the plunger to extrude the paste through the barrel opening in controlled amounts. The cartridge does not include a needle or needle mount, and although it is sterilized, it is intended for non-medical use in the extrusion of semi-solid materials for 3D printing applications.

title: Automated Lumber Bundle Formation System
facts: The Automated Lumber Bundle Formation System is an industrial machine designed to automatically stack lumber planks into organized bundles. It consists of multiple interconnected modules including conveyors, a chain-type distribution module, an unscrambler, speed-up chains, a package maker with pressing foot and secondary lift submodules, and various outfeed and strapping components. The system is composed of several modules that are shipped together for assembly at the destination. The modules include haul-out chain modules, a lumber distribution module, a lumber flow accumulation module, speed-up chains, package maker accumulation transfer units, a package maker, outfeed bundle synchronization module, package outfeed rollers, a strapping machine with infeed and outfeed rollers, a package doubler, and outfeed package transfer conveyors. The system also features a makeup deck and a re-entry bundle sequencing module to manage rejected or reprocessed lumber. All modules function together as a single, integrated unit to automate the bundling process of lumber planks.

title: SpaceRack Roof Rack System
facts: The SpaceRack is a roof rack system designed for a specific motor vehicle. It is composed of extruded aluminum profiles made from alloy EN AW-6063 T66 and laser CNC-cut aluminum plates made from alloy AlMg3 (EN AW-5754), along with stainless steel components and fasteners. The material composition is approximately 70% aluminum and 30% stainless steel by weight. All components are laser-cut to unique vehicle specifications. The system is supplied unassembled as one complete kit, containing all necessary parts for installation. Once assembled, the rack is permanently mounted on the roof of the vehicle to carry loads.

title: 82 Series Single-Hung Window System
facts: The item is a vertically sliding, single-hung window system identified by SKU IGZ-82-SH-3672-EGR. The frame is extruded from unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and reinforced with steel segments. The window incorporates a 19 mm insulated glass unit (IGU). All required hardware and weather seals are included with the window. The configuration is designed for egress purposes.

title: Metal Renaissance Fair Costume
facts: This costume consists of two separate articles: a chest piece and a skirt. Both are constructed from individual aluminum pieces shaped to resemble animal scales and chainmail rings. The chest piece features scalemail on the front and chainmail straps on the back for wearing. The skirt includes scalemail panels on the front and back, suspended from a chainmail belt worn around the waist. All components are assembled using rings to connect the pieces. The costume is designed to resemble armor and is intended for wear at renaissance fairs, typically by individuals portraying a female warrior. The entire costume is made of aluminum, with no other materials used in its construction.

title: NXE 3800E Pre-Install Cable Set
facts: The NXE 3800E Pre-Install Cable Set is a complete assembly consisting of approximately 158 cables or cable bundles and 50 brackets or connectors. The cables include optical fiber, electrical, and communications types. All components are packed together for shipment. The set functions as a component of the NXE 3880E Extreme Ultraviolet semiconductor lithography system and will be incorporated into this system at a semiconductor manufacturing plant in the United States. The set is supplied either as a single shipment or split into two shipments, but all parts are always shipped together for final assembly.

title: PET/Aluminum Composite Film
facts: The product is a composite film consisting of a 12-micron thick layer of PET film, a 6.35-micron thick layer of aluminum foil, and a 2-micron thick 2K-PU adhesive that bonds the PET film and foil together. The layers are dry laminated to form a flexible panel. The film measures 0.020 mm in total thickness. It functions as a passive component in the production of electronic devices, where the aluminum layer serves as an electrically conductive electrode material. The panels are supplied in standard packaging for industrial use and are intended for integration into electronic device manufacturing processes.

title: Steel Compression Limiter
facts: The article is a cylindrical steel component identified by part number PINSS093F. It features an oval inner hole and a knurled outer edge. This component functions as a sleeve or spacer in a fastening system, used exclusively with a bolt or screw on an alternator splash shield cover for a specific motor vehicle. It is pressed into a plastic cover and secured by a flanged hex head bolt, which clamps against the limiter instead of directly on the plastic. The limiter stops further tightening once fully compressed between mounting surfaces, preventing the plastic from being crushed, creeping, or cracking while maintaining consistent clamp force. Its primary purposes are to limit compression of plastic or composite materials during tightening, maintain consistent clamping force, and prevent deformation or damage to surrounding material.

title: Paper Chain Garland
facts: The item is a paper chain garland consisting of 48 strips of flimsy paper in eight bright colors. Each strip measures approximately 11.02 inches by 1.57 inches. The strips feature pre-cut notches that allow the user to interlock and clip them together without additional tape, glue, or fasteners. When assembled by the purchaser, the garland measures approximately 13 feet in length. The product is flat-packed in a transparent polybag with a printed header card. It is marketed and sold as a single-use party decoration.

title: Progesterone Capsules
facts: The product consists of progesterone in capsule form, available in two strengths: 100 mg and 200 mg per capsule. Each capsule is made from a standard gelatin shell, containing progesterone powder as the active ingredient. The capsules are intended for oral ingestion by postmenopausal women to help prevent endometrial hyperplasia when used alongside conjugated estrogens tablets, and for the treatment of secondary amenorrhea. The goods originate from China and are exported from India. They are supplied in sealed bottles, ready for retail or pharmaceutical distribution.

title: Turnout Remover and Carrier System
facts: The Turnout Remover and Carrier System is a self-propelled, diesel-powered machine for railroad infrastructure maintenance and construction. It lifts and transports prefabricated railway track sections such as switch and crossing track panels. The machine has an adjustable rectangular frame that can straddle railway tracks of different gauges, supported by two mobile crawler track bases. Hydraulically powered telescopic columns at each corner enable lifting operations. A central lifting assembly includes a high-capacity hydraulic ram with 1.219 meters of vertical travel and can be fitted with various beam attachments like standard H beams, hydraulic H beams, and hydraulic panel grabs, each featuring anchor points for chains or lift straps. The system includes an engine, a startup control box, and a remote-control receiver for operation. Three models—TRACS Alpha, TRACS Bravo, and TRACS Charlie—share the same functions but differ in overall dimensions and extendibility, with lengths ranging from 3.292 meters to 6.37 meters.

title: Brake Pad Shims
facts: Each brake pad shim is constructed from nitrile rubber, galvanized steel, and a silicone-based adhesive layer. The shim is designed to be attached to a disc brake pad to prevent contact between the vehicle’s brake pads and rotors. These shims also correct minor imperfections in the braking system that may lead to brake noise. The product includes two part numbers: 100321307 and 100321602. The shims are supplied as individual components intended for use in vehicle maintenance and repair.

title: Frozen Shrimp Spring Roll
facts: The product is a frozen shrimp spring roll consisting of a filling enclosed in a rice flour wrapper. The filling contains shrimp (Penaeus vannamei, 44.45 percent), rice flour, water, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, shiitake mushrooms, potato starch, chives, sugar, spring onions, sesame oil, ginger, salt, monosodium glutamate, and white pepper. Each spring roll weighs approximately 35 grams. The spring rolls are individually formed, quick-frozen, and packaged in airtight retail trays containing 20 pieces. The product is imported in a frozen state and requires cooking prior to consumption. It is intended for sale to the foodservice industry as an appetizer or snack.

title: Miniature Studio Equipment Replicas
facts: These are highly detailed, non-functional miniature replicas of historical electronic recording studio equipment, such as synthesizers and rack-mounted digital samplers, created at a 1/6th scale. The items are entirely static display pieces with no electronic components, sound production, or moving parts; all knobs, keys, and faders are rigidly fixed to the chassis. They are intended to serve as collectible decorations specifically for creating miniature studio dioramas. The replicas are manufactured using fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printing with polylactic acid (PLA) plastic as the sole material.

title: VistaView Plus Retractable Fiberglass Screen
facts: This is a retractable screen designed for permanent attachment to framed openings such as patios, large doorways, or windows, providing weather, light, and insect protection. The screen features a polyvinyl chloride (PVC) coated fiberglass mesh woven fabric panel that is 65 percent PVC and 35 percent fiberglass. The fabric is attached to a roll-up mechanism with a pull bar, two guide rails, and a housing for weather protection. The screen retracts horizontally along a track when not in use, offering an unobstructed view, and opens side-to-side by pulling a handle to the desired position. It is custom-built to cover openings up to 21 feet 6 inches wide by 12 feet high, with built-in mounting holes but no separate brackets. The components include a roll tube, aluminum housing, track, receiver, and various mechanical hardware parts, all assembled and packaged in a carton for shipment.

title: huupe ARENA
facts: The huupe ARENA is a video game console designed for basketball training and competition. It uses a sensor array combining LiDAR and radar technology to track basketball shots with over 99% accuracy, operating on the time-of-flight principle by emitting laser light pulses and measuring their return time. The device mounts to the top center of a basketball backboard, connects to LED strips around the backboard's edge, and plugs into an electric outlet. It interfaces with the huupe application to stream real-time game results to televisions, monitors, tablets, laptops, or phones. The console includes pre-loaded games such as counting three-point shots, consecutive shots, and 'swishes,' and interprets shot data to display game-relevant information like point value and free throw eligibility.

title: Aircraft Cockpit Multifunction Control and Display Unit Control Panel Subassembly
facts: The item is a control panel subassembly identified by part number 865-000163-2Z, designed as a component for an aircraft cockpit Multifunction Control and Display Unit (MCDU). It consists of an electronic control assembly mounted on a supportive backplate and a front bezel, featuring several push-button momentary contact switches, LEDs, resistors, photodiodes, a 40-pin electrical connector, and other minor electrical components on a printed circuit board. The subassembly does not include an LCD display and remains uncalibrated and untested for final use. Once imported, an LCD display panel will be added, and the unit will undergo calibration and testing to function as part of the aircraft’s Flight Management System, serving as the interface for the flight crew to input, select, modify, and display flight management information.

title: Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) Suppressors
facts: The goods are three models of one-channel, bidirectional polymer ESD protection devices: AXGD1, PGB1, and XGD. Each device is designed for use with sensitive electronic equipment and high-speed dataline applications. They function by suppressing fast-rising electrostatic discharge transients to preserve signal integrity and minimize data loss when surface mounted within electronic assemblies or circuit board assemblies. All models have a maximum DC voltage rating of 24V. The devices are supplied loose, without any packaging or additional components.

title: MeganeX 8K Mark II
facts: The MeganeX 8K Mark II, model number SVP-VGC4B, is a head-mounted display device for virtual reality use. It features two 1.35-inch micro-OLED screens that present visual content to the user. The device has no internal power source and requires connection to a PC to function. It receives video and automatic data processing signals from an external automatic data processing machine and reproduces them according to user settings. The device lacks an operating system and does not provide interactive capabilities.

title: Eye Injector
facts: The item is an eye injector designed for use by retina specialists to deliver medication into a patient’s eye. It consists of a plastic assembly featuring a barrel, a plunger assembly, an extended stop plunger, and a needle cap. The needle is not included at the time of importation. The injector is intended to be loaded separately with two inserts of a solid dose medication, each containing 1.3 mg of Vorolanib, a tyrosine kinase inhibitor used to treat retinal diseases. During use, the specialist positions the injector at the eye’s limbus and depresses the plunger to release the medication into the eye’s vitreous. The injector is supplied sterile, packaged for single use, and imported without the medication inserts.

title: Men’s Faux Leather Jacket
facts: This is a men's jacket made from a cellular polyurethane plastic outer shell with a 100% polyester woven fabric backing used only for reinforcement. The jacket is lined with woven polyester fabric and quilted with a nonwoven polyester fill batting. It features a sherpa collar, a full front zipper closure, long sleeves with ribbed knit cuffs, one zippered chest pocket, two zippered waist pockets, and ribbed knit bottom cuffs. The jacket is designed for adult male wear and is presented for retail sale.

title: Office Chair Casters
facts: These are swivel casters designed for attachment to the underside of office chair bases. The 3 inch model (RL-3WHL series) includes a galvanized steel grip-ring mounting system measuring 22 mm in length and 10.9 mm in diameter, a steel swiveling housing/yoke, a single wheel approximately 75 mm in diameter and 23.5 mm in width, carbon steel ball bearings, and a galvanized steel axle. The 2 inch model (RL-2WHL series) features a galvanized steel grip-ring mounting system of the same dimensions, a nylon swiveling housing/yoke, two wheels approximately 50 mm in diameter and 23.5 mm in width, and a galvanized steel axle. Both models attach to the chair base by inserting the grip-ring stem into a socket, with wheels rotating on a central axle or ball bearings, and the housing swiveling 360 degrees to enable multidirectional movement across hard floors and carpet. They are sold in retail sets of five casters packaged together in a box.

title: Paper Fringe Banner
facts: The item is a pre-assembled paper party banner identified as SKU # 45534601. It is constructed from multiple layers of colored tissue paper cut into fringe strips that are each 0.39 inches wide and 7.48 inches long. These fringe strips are glued to a continuous polyester string. The overall banner measures approximately 9.84 inches in length and includes string ties at each end for temporary display. The banner is a lightweight, single-use decoration intended for temporary party use. It is marketed and sold specifically as a party decoration.

title: Halloween Decorations
facts: The items include a Light Up Cauldron and a Tree Face and Arms Set, both designed for seasonal indoor or outdoor display to create a spooky atmosphere. The Light Up Cauldron is a battery-powered resin sculpture measuring approximately 10 inches wide, 9 inches deep, and 16 inches high, featuring an illuminated depiction of a witch’s cauldron with a bottle appearing to pour 'Spider Juice' into it. The Tree Face and Arms Set consists of three separate resin pieces: a frightening face measuring approximately 6 inches wide, 4 inches deep, and 12 inches high, and a pair of arms each measuring 14 inches and 12 inches long, both 6 inches wide, sculpted to resemble tree bark with gnarled, grasping fingers, each piece having a keyhole in the back for hanging on a tree.

title: Alpha Eagle
facts: The Alpha Eagle is a self-propelled, boom-mounted machine designed for forestry and vegetation control work. It features an articulated chassis with a permanently integrated 33-foot telescopic hydraulic boom mounted to the side and a 90° rotating cab with wide visibility and in-cab controls. The machine has a 4-wheel drive traction system and is powered by a 4-cylinder, liquid cooled diesel engine producing 173 HP (129 kW). Common tools ordered with the Alpha Eagle include forestry heads with fixed teeth, the New Speed flail head with a hammer-type forestry rotor, cutter discs bars for pruning tree branches, pincers for collecting twigs, and stump grinders for removing the stumps of felled trees.

title: Marzocchi Pompes Hydraulic Units
facts: These hydraulic units, part of the M-ELI1, M-ELI1P, M-ELIK1P, and M-ELI2 series, feature an aluminum casing containing an inlet, an outlet, a flange cover, bearings, and two gears with shafts. The units can be driven by an external motor to function as a pump, or they can receive pressurized oil to reverse gear rotation and operate as a motor. Performance varies across models in terms of speed, suction range, and displacement. The units are supplied new and ready for integration into larger hydraulic systems.

title: Child Size Scarecrow Costume
facts: The costume is a child-size set that includes a pullover dress, socks, and a hat. The dress is made from a flimsy, man-made knitted textile and features a deep back opening closed with a small tab of hook and loop fastener. The short sleeves have narrow exposed elastic stitched with a single line of long, loose, straight stitching and large, visible, loose overlock stitching at the sleeve ends. The waist is half elastic, consisting of a strip of narrow exposed elastic stitched directly to the back of the dress with long, loose straight stitching. A rope belt is glued to the center back of the dress, and the hem also has large, visible, loose overlock stitching.

title: My Melody Darling Adult Costume
facts: The costume is an adult size ensemble that includes a pullover dress and a hooded short cape. The dress is constructed from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features a capped neck and short sleeves with edges folded once and stitched with a single line of long, loose straight stitching. It includes a faux lace-up front with tacked ribbon and a faux apron with large, visible, loose overlock stitching. The dress has a half elastic waist made from a strip of exposed elastic stitched directly to the back with a single line of long, loose straight stitching. The hem of the dress is raw and unfinished. The overall construction uses simple, loose stitching throughout, indicating it is not well-made.

title: Nasal Atomizer Assembly
facts: The item is a nasal atomizer assembly consisting of two components: an atomizer tip and an atomizer body, both made from medical-grade polycarbonate. The atomizer tip is a cone-shaped, injection-molded part that attaches to the atomizer body, a tube-shaped component featuring a central winged grip and a luer lock connector. These components are imported unassembled and are later joined to form the complete nasal atomizer assembly. The assembly connects to a luer lock syringe (not included) to deliver atomized medication into the nasal passage. The atomizer tip uses internal swirl vanes to break liquid medication into fine droplets and its conical shape seals against the patient’s nostril. The assembly functions as an intranasal mucosal atomization device when linked with a syringe, providing a passageway for medication from the syringe to the tip.

title: Wafer Stage Module
facts: The Wafer Stage Module type NXE MK 1 is a component of the ASML NXE Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) semiconductor photolithography system. It is a rectangular box-like structure designed to position silicon wafers during metrology and exposure processes. The module features a magnetic levitation base that suspends and moves two integrated wafer tables, also known as chucks, without physical contact. One wafer table holds and aligns a silicon wafer under a metrology unit for measurement, while the second wafer table positions under the EUV light source unit. The metrology unit and EUV light source unit are separate components and are not included with the Wafer Stage Module. The module is imported separately from the Netherlands.

title: Men’s Insulated Extreme Cold Boot
facts: This is an above-the-ankle men’s waterproof boot, style number 87013, featuring two pull loops at the top edge. The upper’s outer surface is made primarily of rubber and plastic. The outer sole is constructed from rubber and plastic and is covered with a thick layer of leather flocking that fully hides the rubber and plastic material beneath. The leather flocking is both visible and can be felt on the surface of the sole. The boot is designed for cold-weather use and includes insulation for thermal protection.

title: Used 2000 Nissan Skyline 25GT-X Sedan
facts: This is a used four-door sedan from the 2000 model year manufactured by Nissan in Japan. The vehicle is designed to seat five passengers including the driver. It is powered by a Nissan RB25DE 6-cylinder spark-ignition internal combustion piston engine with a displacement of 2,500cc. The engine has an aftermarket exhaust system but otherwise remains unmodified. The vehicle includes cosmetic and suspension modifications such as aftermarket wheels, coilover suspension, and a body kit.

title: Authentic 35mm Cinema-Shown Film Cell Collectible Display
facts: The item is a decorative wall art display intended for home viewing. It consists of a plastic frame holding a Perspex cover and a mountboard. A graphic of a movie poster for The Godfather is mounted on the display. Twelve original, authentic 35mm film cells cut from positive release prints of the feature film The Godfather are arranged around the poster graphic. The display may include an external, thin, low-voltage LED lightbox unit mounted on the back to illuminate the transparent film cells. If the LED lightbox is not selected, the display core is fitted with clear acrylic plastic sheets on both sides to protect the assembly while allowing natural ambient light to pass through the film cells. The display also includes a metal plaque bearing an individual serial or edition number.

title: Midodrine Hydrochloride Bulk Powder
facts: The product is a white to off-white crystalline powder supplied in bulk form, composed of Midodrine Hydrochloride with CAS number 3092-17-9. It is manufactured through a chemical synthesis process and shipped in sealed containers for pharmaceutical use. The active ingredient functions as a prodrug that converts to desglymidodrine, an alpha-1 adrenergic agonist, and is intended for therapeutic application in treating symptomatic orthostatic hypotension. The powder is provided without any dosage formulation or packaging for direct consumer sale, meant for further pharmaceutical processing. It is supplied from Italy and weighs according to container specifications.

title: TS 8 Baying System
facts: The TS 8 Baying System is a series of floor-standing steel storage cabinets measuring approximately 31.5 inches in width, 78.7 inches in height, and 23.6 inches in depth. The cabinets are constructed from powder-coated steel and include vertical and horizontal panels, vertical upright mounting rails, a single hinged front door, a roof plate, a base plate, and a mounting plate. These cabinets are designed to be joined on the left or right sides to form larger modular configurations. They are intended to securely hold computer server equipment, circuit breakers, busbars, fuses, relays, networking devices, power-distribution units, power supplies, switching devices, wiring, and additional hardware components, which are sold separately. The cabinets are delivered empty and unequipped, requiring assembly by the user.

title: Dried Poppy Heads
facts: The merchandise consists of naturally grown poppy seed capsules (Papaver somniferum) that have been harvested and dried with no added materials or substances. The poppy heads are intended solely for decorative use in home décor, floral arrangements, arts and crafts, and interior design applications. They are not intended for planting, propagation, food, pharmaceutical, medicinal, or narcotic purposes. The drying process renders the product unsuitable for cultivation. The merchandise is exported to the United States in protective cartons and is available in a variety of retail and wholesale pack sizes.

title: LPD Strainers
facts: These are LPD strainers, models LPD0300, LPD1000, and LPD2400, designed to protect fluid system components such as pumps, valves, and heat exchangers by removing particulate matter and debris from process media. Each unit has an internal stainless-steel perforated screen inside a body made from either cast iron or ductile iron, depending on the model size. They feature a specialized internal geometry and an oversized screen that reduces pressure drop compared to conventional models. The strainers have no moving parts and can be installed horizontally or vertically in water, oil, gas, and other compatible fluid-service applications. Each unit includes integral flanges, a hinged bolted cover plate, and blowoff plugs to aid in maintenance and operation. The models differ only in size, shape, and composition.

title: MJMA02 Helix 2 Power Mobility Scooter
facts: The MJMA02 Helix 2 Power Mobility Scooter is a four-wheeled, battery-powered device intended for individuals with limited mobility. It features a four-wheel steering system, a removable footrest extension, anti-tip rear wheels, a 4-way adjustable tiller, and an adjustable padded backrest. The scooter has a fold-flat design for easy storage and includes a Li-Ion 24 Volt / 5.8 AH battery, head and rear lights, a horn, and a megaphone. It is designed to provide stable, comfortable, independent movement over flat indoor or outdoor surfaces for daily activities, errands, community participation, or commuting.

title: Folding Utility Knife
facts: The item is a manually operated folding utility knife, item number D280180, intended for general cutting applications such as cutting cardboard, plastic, and other common materials. It features a locking mechanism that secures a replaceable standard utility blade in position and includes a quick-change system for easy blade replacement. The knife is constructed primarily from zinc alloy and stainless steel. The package includes the knife, a replacement blade, and an attached screwdriver.

title: Paper Flower-Making Kit
facts: The product is a craft kit designed for making crepe paper flowers. Each kit contains between four and eight rectangular sheets of colored, creped paper, along with 6 to 12 pieces of 7-inch florist’s steel wire. The kit also includes printed instructions and templates to guide the assembly process. Retail customers are expected to provide scissors and glue to cut and assemble the flowers according to the instructions. The paper is manufactured in Italy and is specified not to be kraft paper. The kit is packaged for retail sale, intended for use by individuals wishing to create decorative paper flowers.

title: Conductive Silver Paste
facts: The product is a conductive silver paste intended for use in electronic and solar applications. It is composed of U.S.-origin silver powder making up less than 90% by weight, glass powder/frit from Taiwan less than 3% by weight, polymer in solvent from Taiwan less than 8% by weight, and organic additives from Taiwan less than 1% by weight. The silver powder is exported from the United States to Taiwan where it is mechanically mixed with binders and additives to form the paste. After reimportation into the United States, the paste is screen-printed onto electronic or solar substrates and thermally cured. The final product is sold in its current form for application in electronic and solar manufacturing processes.

title: Household Kitchen Dish Racks
facts: These are kitchen countertop dish racks intended for household use near sinks to hold plates, bowls, glasses, and cutlery for drying. Each unit includes a plastic dish rack, plastic basin, plastic tray stand with a plastic drain spout, plastic side drip tray, four plastic feet, and a plastic utensil holder. The dish rack sides are made of steel and feature U-shaped steel wire glass/cup holders and a steel wire for wine glasses, with a removable steel wire rack inside. SKU KT2103 additionally includes a seven-slot plastic knife block inserted into the utensil holder. The racks measure between approximately 15.00 to 22.30 inches in length, 6.50 to 11.50 inches in height, and 7.00 to 13.50 inches in width.

title: Electronic Parking Brake Actuator Assembly
facts: The item is an electro-mechanical actuator identified by part number 51788010, designed for automotive electronic parking brake systems. It contains a 12V brushed DC motor with a maximum output of 170W, a multi-stage reduction gear mechanism, a housing, an output shaft, electronic connectors, seals, and internal actuating components. The assembly functions by generating brake clamping force to apply and release the parking brake when mated to a brake caliper assembly. The brake calipers and brake pistons are separate components not included with this assembly. The unit operates on a 12V power source and is packaged for direct installation in vehicle brake systems.

title: Weber Built-In Stainless Steel Outdoor Kitchen Storage Components
facts: These are stainless steel metal storage units designed for installation in custom standalone outdoor kitchen areas alongside grills. The components include single-door cabinets (available as left and right handle units), double-door cabinets in 32-inch and 38-inch sizes, a triple-drawer unit, a door-and-drawer combo unit in 32-inch and 38-inch sizes, an LP tank storage drawer, and a trash bin drawer with metal rails. All units are made from stainless steel and are intended for household use. None of the components interlock with electric or gas grills, are specific to a particular grill model, or are attached to a grill or range. Dimensions vary by model, with lengths ranging from 629 mm to 685.9 mm, widths from 533 mm to 967 mm, and heights from 508 mm to 711 mm. LP tanks and trash bins are sold separately.

title: Handheld Hair Mesotherapy Device
facts: The item is a handheld, electrically powered device designed for personal scalp care at home. It has a pen-shaped plastic body and contains a rechargeable lithium-ion battery. An internal electric motor drives reciprocating needles that penetrate the scalp surface to create micro-channels, intended to enhance the absorption of topical hair care serums. The device also includes electrical muscle stimulation (EMS) to deliver a low-level microcurrent to the scalp for cosmetic stimulation. It features a detachable 3 milliliter serum reservoir and an LED display with touch-button control. The device measures approximately 153 millimeters in length by 31 millimeters in width and weighs approximately 140 grams without an attached needle cartridge. It is packaged in a retail box that includes a charging base, USB cable, a sample 12-pin needle cartridge, and an instruction manual.

title: Highfield Sport 390 Rigid Hull Inflatable Boat with Tohatsu Outboard Motor
facts: The item is a Highfield Sport 390 rigid hull inflatable boat designed for fitting with an outboard motor. The boat measures approximately 3.9 meters in length and has an unladen (net) weight of 226 kilograms. It is constructed with a rigid hull and inflatable sections, providing stability and buoyancy. The boat is intended for recreational water use and is suitable for use by adults. At the time of importation, the boat will be presented together with a corresponding Tohatsu outboard motor, which was purchased on the same invoice. The motor is specifically designed to be fitted to this boat model, and both items will be imported together in the same shipment. The boat and motor are packaged for retail sale and intended for use in freshwater and saltwater environments.

title: Toshiba All-In-One Devices
facts: The Toshiba TCx620, TCx810, and TCx820 are single, complete, functional units that include a touchscreen display, Intel CPU, Random Access Memory (RAM), solid state drive (SSD) storage, and either Windows IoT or Android operating system. They feature Ethernet/USB connectivity, an RJ45 serial interface, an optional SIM card slot, and Wi-Fi capability. These devices can connect to peripheral devices such as keyboards, mice, cash drawers, receipt printers, barcode scanners, magnetic stripe readers, NFC payment readers, card readers, or external payment terminals using standard connections like USB, USB-C, or ethernet. The peripherals are sold separately and are not pre-installed. The devices are not preloaded with any payment processing software but can be freely programmed by the customer for various uses, including retail point-of-sale functions, inventory management, servers, and back-office support. They are primarily purchased for retail use but also serve other business functions.

title: Feeling Lucky Click Message Pen
facts: The item is a retractable ballpoint pen designed for writing with black ink. It features a pink plastic barrel and includes green plastic accents and a clip. The pen has a click top mechanism that, when pressed, rotates pre-set messages visible through two clear plastic windows on either side of the barrel. Six distinct messages appear in sequence, such as 'Luck is coming your way' and 'All signs point to yes.' The pen targets users aged 14 and older and is intended for sale in art, craft, and gift shops as a novelty writing instrument. It is packaged on a blister card for retail display and distribution.

title: Girls' School Uniform Dress
facts: Style SZ9201 is a girls' one-piece dress made from both knit and woven fabrics. The upper portion is a white woven shirt made from 55 percent cotton and 45 percent polyester, with a pointed collar, a partial front opening secured with two buttons, and short hemmed sleeves. Over this shirt is a rib-knit sleeveless overlay made from 60 percent cotton and 40 percent polyester, permanently sewn to the shirt. The lower portion is a pleated skirt made entirely of 100 percent polyester woven fabric, also permanently sewn to the upper part. The dress extends from the shoulder to approximately the mid-thigh and is intended for school uniform wear.

title: Steel Latch Actuation Rods for Vehicle Doors
facts: These are steel rods designed for use in vehicle door systems. Each rod connects the exterior door handle to the internal latch mechanism, transmitting the force applied when the handle is pulled to allow the door to open. The rods are manufactured from steel and have no independent mechanical function or locking capability. They are specific components of the door opening and closing system, not part of the lock mechanism itself. The rods come in four variations: front left (Part Number B9000847), front right (Part Number B9000848), rear left (Part Number B9000849), and rear right (Part Number B9000850). Each rod is supplied individually and is intended exclusively for installation within vehicle door assemblies.

title: Mini Soccer Pitch Kit
facts: The mini soccer pitch kit is a complete, unassembled set intended for assembly after importation and use in playing soccer. The kit contains steel posts and goal-end bays, artificial turf, rebound boards, stainless steel fasteners, and netting. Once assembled, the pitch measures approximately 18.35 meters in length by 9.14 meters in width. All components are supplied for self-assembly, with no additional hardware or materials required. The artificial turf provides a playing surface, while the steel frame and netting form the pitch boundaries and goal structure. The kit is designed for outdoor recreational use and is sold as a complete package for end-user assembly.

title: Dolomite Photo Frame
facts: The item is a rectangular picture frame made from dolomite ceramic, measuring approximately 8 inches high by 6 inches wide. It features a paperboard easel attached to the back to allow it to stand upright on a surface. The frame is designed to hold a standard 4” x 6” photograph. Two decorative styles are available: one with a red-and-white checkerboard pattern and pink hearts around the border, and the other with a blue-and-white checkerboard pattern with pink hearts and printed letters “X” and “O” around the border. The frames are sold under the brand name Joyward® and are stocked by CVS Pharmacy under item number 914711.

title: Glass Bird-Shaped Tealight Candle Holder
facts: The item is a decorative candle holder shaped like a bird in mid-flight, featuring spread wings, a split tail, and a rounded head. It is made from thick, smooth, clear glass. The body of the bird includes a circular recessed well designed to hold a single standard-sized tealight or votive candle. The candle holder measures approximately 4.53 inches in length, 3.94 inches in width, and 1.69 inches in height. The design allows the candle light to shine without obstruction. It is clearly labeled as a candle holder for consumer visibility.

title: Women’s sleeveless poncho
facts: The item is a women’s sleeveless poncho made from a knit fabric composed of 94% polyester, 3% wool, 1% spandex, and 2% other fibers. It is a pullover style that covers the elbows and ends at the waist. The poncho has a round neckline and a bottom edge finished with knotted fringe. It is designed for wear by women and is intended as an outer garment.

title: Hermit Crab Habitat Products
facts: These are five finished pet habitat products made entirely from polylactic acid (PLA) plastic filament using additive 3D printing. All items are designed for use by pet land hermit crabs kept in household terrariums, also called crabitats. Item 1 is an XL walk-in water pool kit with two pools measuring approximately 9.02 inches long by 5.12 inches wide by 3.31 inches high and two removable splash trays measuring approximately 9.45 inches long by 5.91 inches wide by 0.39 inches high, allowing hermit crabs to enter, submerge, and exit fresh or prepared marine salt water. Item 2 is a feeding and foraging dish measuring approximately 5.91 inches long by 4.72 inches wide by 2.76 inches high, holding food and pet-safe natural forage materials. Item 3 is a climbing and enrichment structure measuring approximately 3.94 inches long by 3.15 inches wide by 3.15 inches high, providing climbing, exploration, and environmental enrichment. Item 4 is a habitat shelf/elevated platform measuring approximately 9.45 inches long by 5.12 inches wide by 2.56 inches high, mounting to the side of the cage to create additional elevated space for climbing, resting, and enrichment. Item 5 is a multi-level habitat platform measuring approximately 3.54 inches long by 3.94 inches wide by 5.91 inches high, offering elevated space for replacement shells, feeding, climbing, and environmental enrichment.

title: Dog-eared wood pickets
facts: These are fence pickets made from Southern Yellow Pine, a coniferous wood. Each picket measures 5 1/2 inches wide, 72 inches long, and 5/8 of an inch thick. The top two corners of each picket are cut at a 45-degree angle. The pickets are of standard length for fencing applications. They are sold individually to retailers for use in constructing fences.

title: Boxed Aluminum Foil for Hair Highlighting
facts: The product is aluminum foil supplied in boxed form for use in hair salons for highlighting hair. The foil is available in three thicknesses: 0.012 mm, 0.015 mm, and 0.018 mm, with a consistent width of 120 mm (4.72 inches). Each roll of foil weighs 5 pounds and is packaged for import in this boxed configuration.

title: FloPath Series Pressure and Flow Measuring Instruments
facts: The FloPath series includes three models: PFM1, PFM1-A, and PFM1-T. All models are pressure measuring devices with a shared multi-channel, multi-file logging architecture. The PFM1 model is a decentralized data logger with 2MB of non-volatile flash memory, capable of recording up to eight independent data streams simultaneously. It operates silently in submersed environments and requires manual data retrieval and configuration updates via a non-contact USB-to-IrDA infrared link. The PFM1-A model includes the same pressure logging capability as the PFM1 but adds a long-range cellular telemetry module for automatic data transmission over cloud-hosted platforms. The PFM1-T model features a dual-speed architecture for advanced fluid dynamics analysis, maintaining standard slow-speed trend logging while monitoring for threshold violations at 10Hz. When a pressure anomaly is detected, it activates a high-speed engine to capture transient events at up to 1,000 readings per second, isolates these events into separate files, and triggers an immediate cellular alarm.

title: Fento Max knee protectors
facts: The Fento Max knee protectors, product number F280440, are protective pads designed to support and safeguard the knee joint while kneeling. They consist of an outer layer made from ethylene-vinyl acetate (EVA) plastic foam and an inner layer composed of polyurethane (PU) plastic foam. Elastic straps made from polyester are attached to secure the protectors around the knee. The protectors are supplied as single units, each intended for one knee, and are packaged for retail or wholesale distribution.

title: Can-Am Outlander PRO
facts: The Can-Am Outlander PRO is a four-wheeled, operator-riding all-terrain vehicle (ATV) powered by a 650cc spark-ignition internal combustion engine. It features a straddle seat and handlebar steering, and includes both two-wheel drive (2WD) and four-wheel drive (4WD) systems. The vehicle is designed for operation on uneven, unprepared, and restricted-access terrain such as farms, ranches, and construction sites. It is equipped with front and rear cargo racks with a combined carrying capacity of 360 pounds and has towing capability. The ATV is intended for professional and recreational use, enhancing its suitability for work-oriented applications while maintaining its fundamental character as an operator-riding ATV.

title: Paperboard Keepsake Box
facts: The item is a rigid paperboard box covered with high gloss paper, measuring 13.5 inches long by 10 inches wide by 4.75 inches high. It features a hinged lid with a slot cut in the lid and side for inserting a ribbon to secure the box. The box is designed for repetitive use after importation. It will be imported containing a blanket and a children’s book, though these items are entered separately. The box will be printed on both the inside and outside to coordinate with its contents. A paperboard belly band, indicating the title of the book and identifying the contents, is included with the box.

title: Bulgar Freekeh
facts: Bulgar Freekeh is a green wheat product that is flame-roasted using its own husk and straw during processing. No cooking methods such as boiling, steaming, or parboiling are used at any stage of manufacture. The product is imported in 55-pound plastic sacks. After importation, it will be repackaged for retail sale. It is intended for use as a rice alternative in food preparations.

title: 10” LCD Sketch Pro Neo Pad bundle
facts: The bundle includes a 10-inch electronic writing surface and a stylus. The writing surface is constructed from a cholesteric LCD layer enclosed between plastic sheets and housed in a plastic shell. An erase button is located on the bottom of the device. Pressing the surface with the stylus changes the alignment of the liquid crystals, making written or drawn lines visible. Depressing the erase button triggers an internal circuit that sends an electrical pulse, realigning the liquid crystals and erasing the content. The device is designed for users to write or draw directly on the surface and then clear it. It is powered internally and supplied in retail packaging for consumer sale.

title: Bupropion Hydrochloride Extended-Release Tablets
facts: These are Bupropion Hydrochloride tablets designed to release the active ingredient over an extended period. The tablets are manufactured in a dosage form for oral administration. They are intended for medical use in the treatment of major depressive disorder and seasonal affective disorder. The product is supplied from India in sealed packaging suitable for retail or pharmaceutical distribution.

title: Ranolazine Extended-Release Tablets
facts: These are oral dosage form tablets containing the active pharmaceutical ingredient ranolazine in extended-release formulation. The tablets are manufactured in India for human therapeutic use as a medication to treat chronic angina. They function by inhibiting the late inward sodium current in heart muscle cells, which helps prevent intracellular calcium overload and reduces cardiac wall tension. The tablets are intended for adult patients and are taken orally as prescribed by a healthcare professional. They are supplied in sealed packaging suitable for retail pharmaceutical distribution.

title: Land-Based Autonomous Environmental DNA Sampler
facts: The product is an autonomous environmental DNA sampler designed for shore-based installation. It consists of a permanently assembled housing containing an internal frame, a pump with a fluid path, a water intake tube, a filter carousel with sample holder cases, an automated preservation subsystem, a UV antifouling emitter, electronic controls, and a cellular/satellite telemetry module. The pump draws a measured volume of water from an adjacent body of water through the intake tube. The water passes through a disposable membrane filter that captures suspended particulate matter, including cellular material and DNA fragments. The filtered water is returned to the environment. The filter is moved to a sealed holder in the carousel and undergoes an automated drying and chemical fixation process to preserve the captured material. The sampler can handle up to 96 filter positions and the sealed sample holders are later removed for laboratory analysis.

title: Kaspi Bookshelves
facts: These are floor-standing, ready-to-assemble wooden bookshelves available in Large, Medium, and Small models. They are constructed from medium density fiberboard (MDF) panels with polyvinylchloride (PVC) edge banding and melamine-finished surfaces. Each bookshelf is flat-packed and includes knock-down camlock hardware and dowel pins for assembly. After assembly, each model features four tiers of shelving and four front-facing display levels, allowing books to be positioned with covers outward for visibility and ease of access. The bookshelves are intended primarily for use in homes, classrooms, reading areas, playrooms, early-learning environments, and similar residential or educational spaces. All three items measure approximately 18.5 inches wide and 24.8 inches high. Their lengths vary: the Large model is 36.8 inches, the Medium model is 25 inches, and the Small model is 13.2 inches.

title: Kaspi Rolling Drawer Storage Cube
facts: The Kaspi Rolling Drawer is available in Natural (RDN1273) and White (RDW1273) color finishes. Each unit is flat-packed and requires assembly by the consumer. The storage cube is constructed from medium density fiberboard (MDF) panels with polyvinylchloride (PVC) edge banding and a melamine surface finish. Assembly uses included knock-down camlock hardware and dowel pins. The unit features four swivel casters for mobility, a single pull string handle, and an internal cavity for storing and organizing objects. The product measures approximately 10.8 inches in length, 10.8 inches in width, and 11.8 inches in height.

title: MagnaLatch Series 3 Pool Gate Latch
facts: The MagnaLatch Series 3 is a key-operated locking device for pool gates, constructed from metal and plastic components. It measures approximately 20.5 inches in height. The lower portion features a steel door latch mechanism, while the upper section includes a brass 6-pin keyed lock, a locked indicator, and a pull-knob used to unlatch the gate. The device comes with mounting hardware for installation. It is designed to be installed on pool gates with the lock and pull-knob positioned at a height that satisfies pool safety code requirements.

title: Pokémon Character Sticker
facts: The item is a rectangular paper sticker measuring approximately 5 centimeters by 7 centimeters. It features two distinct Pokémon character illustrations placed side-by-side, each accompanied by Japanese text that identifies the character and highlights its characteristic features. The sticker is a printed collectible produced by Bandai in 1996. It is intended for decorative or collectible use, typically applied to personal items such as notebooks, folders, or other surfaces. The sticker is made from standard printing paper and is supplied individually, often in sealed packaging for retail distribution.

title: Industrial Water Cooling Tower
facts: The article is an industrial steel water cooling tower, model OTTX-250L, with an induced-draft, cross-flow, and open-circuit design. It includes a cold-water basin, a hot-water basin, and dual vertical fill banks mounted in a structural frame enclosed by panels. Hot process water flows by gravity over PVC packing in the fill banks, located on opposite sides of the unit. An induced-draft fan assembly with an axial air-foil fan at the top draws ambient air into the unit, where it flows perpendicular to the falling water, passes through drift eliminators, and exits the tower. Heat is transferred through direct water-air contact by evaporation, and the cooled water collects in the cold-water basin at the base for return to process equipment. The unit has a cooling capacity of 975,000 kcal per hour and measures approximately 2.4 meters in length, 4.4 meters in width, and 3.19 meters in height.

title: Hand Drawn Watercolor Portraits
facts: These are 130 individual, unframed watercolor composition drawing place cards created by artist Alice Wang. Each place card is a personalized portrait measuring approximately 3.94 inches wide and 5.91 inches long, featuring a specific wedding guest's pose, facial features, expression, and name, along with optional decorative design elements. The artwork is executed entirely by hand on blank watercolor paper using brushes, watercolor, ink/calligraphy pens, colored pencil/crayons, acrylic markers, glitter pens, and other materials. The creation process begins with hand-drawn pencil compositions, followed by outlining with ink, applying watercolor, adding details such as facial features and clothing, and finally inking the subject's name. Each portrait takes approximately 30 minutes to complete, is an original artwork, and bears the artist's signature on the reverse side. The portraits are air-dried, inspected, and then packed for export to the United States.

title: Assembled Wooden Furniture Cabinet Panel
facts: The item is an assembled wooden furniture cabinet panel intended for installation onto wooden cabinet furniture as doors and drawers. It measures between 10-42 inches long, 4-24 inches wide, and 3/4 inch thick. The panel is constructed from a particleboard base, with edges banded using lumber and solid hardwood staves. The surface is covered with a 1 mm veneer made from beech, maple, or red oak, and it is not stained, painted, or otherwise surface coated. The components are assembled without additional finishing or decorative treatments.

title: Frozen Raw Ground Yellowfin Tuna Products
facts: These products consist of frozen, raw, gutted, and skinless yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares) combined with seasonings, proteins, oils, and other ingredients to enhance moisture retention, texture, appearance, yield, flavor, and overall performance. The first product, Tuna Sausage, is made from tuna cutoffs ground and blended with water, salt, sodium phosphate, maltodextrin, carrageenan, sodium erythorbate, pea fiber, potato fiber, ascorbic acid, beet powder, annatto extract, sodium nitrite, soybean oil, and a seasoning blend. The mixture is stuffed into beef collagen casings containing glycerol and sodium carboxymethylcellulose and formed into sausages, packaged as four 90-gram sausages in a high-barrier plastic bag, with 13 bags per 4.68-kilogram box. The second product, Ground Tuna, is made from tuna cutoffs ground and blended with water, salt, sodium phosphate, maltodextrin, carrageenan, sodium erythorbate, pea fiber, potato fiber, ascorbic acid, beet powder, annatto extract, and sodium nitrite, packaged in one-pound quantities in high-barrier plastic bags, with 10 bags per 10-pound box. The third product, Tuna Burger Patties, is made from tuna cutoffs ground and blended with water, salt, sodium phosphate, maltodextrin, carrageenan, sodium erythorbate, pea fiber, potato fiber, ascorbic acid, beet powder, annatto extract, sodium nitrite, onion, soybean oil, soy protein, and a seasoning blend, formed into burger patties and packaged as four 100-gram patties in high-barrier plastic film, with 24 packages per 9.6-kilogram box. The fourth product, Seasoned Tuna Cubes (also identified as Carnitas), is made from tuna cutoffs ground and blended with water, salt, sodium phosphate, maltodextrin, carrageenan, sodium erythorbate, pea fiber, potato fiber, ascorbic acid, beet powder, annatto extract, sodium nitrite, mustard, garlic, sugar, and spices, packaged in one-pound quantities in high-barrier plastic bags, with 10 bags per 10-pound box. All products are intended for human consumption in commercial food-service applications.

title: Renaissance Costume Shirt
facts: This is a long-sleeved pullover shirt made from a flimsy, man-made woven textile. It features a stand collar and a deep back opening, which is closed with two tabs of hook and loop fastener. The front neck is lace-up with metal eyelets and a flimsy string tie. Each long sleeve has a one-piece folded band cuff, finished with large, visible, loose overlock stitching and closed with a single tab of hook and loop fastener. The shirt hem is also finished with large, visible, loose overlock stitching.

title: Truffle Quail Eggs
facts: The product is a ready-to-eat cooked egg product intended for direct human consumption. It consists of quail eggs combined with brewed soy sauce, sugar, glucose, dextrin, olive oil, black truffle oil (a mixture of olive oil, truffle oil, and flavoring), fruit wine, refined salt, and additional flavoring. The eggs are heat treated, fully cooked, and seasoned before importation. The finished product is imported in a retail-ready hermetically sealed pouch, designed for immediate consumption without any further preparation or processing.

title: Shinto ceremonial arrow souvenir
facts: The item is a decorative arrow known as Hamaya, measuring approximately 45 centimeters in length. It is constructed from pine wood and features turkey feathers attached to one end. Small brass bells are incorporated into the design, and a decorative paper tag is affixed to the arrow. The arrow lacks a pointed tip or arrowhead and is not designed for use as a functional archery arrow. It is intended for display in homes as a traditional Shinto shrine souvenir to ward off evil spirits and invite auspicious energy.

title: Steel hinge pin for KitchenAid stand mixer
facts: The article is a precision-machined steel hinge pin, zinc-plated, headless and unthreaded. It measures approximately 3.20 inches in length and 0.373 inches in diameter, with chamfered ends and dimensional tolerances for precise fitting. The pin functions as the pivot axle for the tilt-head mechanism in a KitchenAid household stand mixer, connecting the mixer head to the lower housing to allow rotational movement between operating and service positions. It is designed to Whirlpool/KitchenAid specifications and serves as an essential component of the mixer's tilt-head mechanism. The pin is supplied individually and intended for incorporation into the specified appliance assembly.

title: Pipe Breather and Purge Assemblies for Motor Vehicles
facts: These items are pipe breather and purge sub-assemblies made for use in motor vehicles, including sedans, smaller cars, and small sport utility vehicles. Each assembly contains metal pipes, stays, plates, hoses, and clamps. They manage crankcase pressure and vapors, route engine coolant, or connect purge-control components to safely handle fuel vapors. The assemblies are pre-fabricated components intended for installation in vehicle engines to support emission control and temperature regulation. All parts are supplied as complete sub-assemblies ready for integration into vehicle systems.

title: Pipe Breather Subassemblies for Motor Vehicles
facts: These items are pipe breather subassemblies intended for use in sedans and smaller motor vehicles. Each subassembly functions to relieve internal crankcase pressure and return blow-by gases to the vehicle's intake system for combustion. The subassemblies are composed of metal and rubber components. Part number 1713A-5MR-A000 includes a breather pipe assembly, two water hose assemblies, and a tube clamp. Part number 1713A-61A-A010 includes a breather pipe assembly, a water hose assembly, and a tube clamp. Part numbers 1713A-69F-A001, 1713A-6MD-A000, and 1713B-69F-A000 each include a breather pipe, a hose clamp, and a rubber breather joint. All items are supplied as complete subassemblies ready for installation.

title: Metalogix Revolution External Plating System
facts: The Metalogix Revolution External Plating System is a modular external fixation platform consisting of plates (foot, I, n, J, and C plates), tibial blocks (cascade and stacked), forefoot bridges, posts, threaded rods, SuperStruts, wires, half-pins, nuts, bolts, washers, and related instrumentation. Components are assembled by surgeons to create patient-specific external fixation constructs for stabilizing bone, correcting deformities, supporting arthrodesis/fusion procedures, facilitating limb reconstruction, and providing prolonged stabilization during healing. The system is indicated for treating both acute conditions such as fracture and trauma, and chronic conditions including deformity correction, joint fusion, nonunion or delayed healing, bone loss, and soft tissue reconstruction. Key features include angular adjustment, compression, distraction, and frame positioning capabilities via SuperStruts, and foot plates with multiple rows of holes and dedicated walker rail mounting holes to support patient mobility during treatment. The system is designed for prolonged stabilization and structural correction in chronic or permanent physical impairments, particularly for conditions such as Charcot neuroarthropathy, chronic foot and ankle deformity, arthrodesis/fusion, nonunion, bone loss, diabetic wound care/offloading, and complex reconstruction.

title: Precision Home Repair Tool Set
facts: The item is a precision home repair tool set designed for general household maintenance tasks. It consists of a rigid plastic carrying case with a sliding cover and multiple custom compartments for organized storage. The case measures 7.28 inches in length, 2.17 inches in width, and 2.17 inches in height, and the complete set weighs 0.981 pounds. The set includes one aluminum bit driver, one steel flex extension bar, one steel adapter, eighteen double-ended steel bits, thirty-two single-ended steel bits, one small steel pry bar, and one set of small steel tweezers. All tools are made from either aluminum or steel as specified. The complete set is packaged in a retail-ready blister pack for direct sale to consumers.

title: Decorative Textile Wall Hangings
facts: These are decorative wall hangings available in various designs, shapes, and sizes typically ranging from 5 to 18 inches. They are produced by inserting acrylic, cotton, and wool yarns into pre-existing cotton woven fabric using an electric tufting machine, which creates a loop-pile surface. The pile surface is secured with adhesive on the reverse side of the cotton cloth, and a secondary backing of felt is applied. A metal D-ring hanging fixture is attached to the felt backing to allow the article to be displayed on a wall. The surface area of each piece consists chiefly of acrylic yarn (more than 50 percent) with lesser quantities of cotton and/or wool yarns, depending on the design. The wool yarn is sourced from Canada, while the acrylic and cotton yarns, woven cotton fabric, and felt backing may come from various suppliers worldwide. Tufting and final assembly are performed in Canada.

title: Organic Gypsum Prill Soil Amendments
facts: These products are granulated soil amendments supplied in prill form. The base product contains Falkland Gypsum combined with a Cameron Coat Binder. A second variant adds Rock Phosphate to the gypsum and binder mixture. A third variant includes an additional Micro CalPlus Coating applied over the base components. All products are low-dust granules designed for agricultural use to supply calcium and sulfur, loosen compacted soils, improve drainage, and help leach salts and aluminum. The granules are manufactured through a coating process that applies the binder and optional additives to the gypsum base material.

title: Topgolf-branded recreational games
facts: These are four backyard games that combine golf elements with other outdoor games. Each game includes an artificial turf tee mat and a storage bag. Three of the games feature an oversized adjustable plastic golf club that ranges from 22 to 35 inches in length. The Topgolf Bump n’ Run includes a target board with a fabric face, propped up with plastic poles, nine scoring holes lined with netting, and four foam practice balls. The Topgolf Top Score includes a 4-foot by 6-foot cloth target with ten Velcro-compatible scoring areas and eight foam practice balls in two team colors. The Topgolf Chipping Targets include three collapsible circular targets of varying diameters constructed from folding plastic rings with nylon netting, eight foam practice balls, and a score pad. The Topgolf Top Shot includes a 7-foot circular target/driving net constructed from fiberglass rings, a plastic base/frame, and stitched nylon netting, along with 20 foam training balls in four team colors. Players use the golf club and tee mat to chip or strike the foam balls toward the targets or net to score points based on where the balls land.

title: Automotive Snap Rings
facts: These are four snap rings identified by part numbers 45956-01980, 49556-02320, 49556-02420, and 49556-02590, each made from SK5 high-carbon steel. The rings are manufactured by blanking steel to shape, heat treating for increased strength and hardness, barreling to remove burrs, and inspecting for accuracy, hardness, and elasticity. Each ring is designed for insertion into a machined groove on a motor vehicle drive shaft assembly to secure a trunnion in position, preventing axial movement and dislodgement due to operational loads and vibrations. The rings also maintain trunnion position during telescoping or plunging movements of the drive shaft. Dimensions vary: part 45956-01980 measures 1.2 × 25 × 25 mm; part 49556-02320 measures 1.2 × 27.7 × 27.7 mm; part 49556-02420 measures 1.2 × 28.7 × 28.7 mm; and part 49556-02590 measures 1.2 × 30.4 × 30.4 mm. All rings share the same configuration and function, differing only in size.

title: igus Mobile Shore Power Outlet System
facts: The igus Mobile Shore Power Outlet (iMSPO) system connects externally generated shore power to a berthed vessel. The iMSPO carriage is a self-propelled shore-side electrical interface that can be positioned at any point along a marine terminal berth. It includes two drive motor/gearbox/wheel assemblies rated at 400/480 V, three-phase, up to 36 kW each; socket boxes rated at 6.6 kV or 11 kV; one or more medium-voltage sockets; and a control cabinet with a PLC, motor drives, a sensor package, communications equipment, and a 400/480 V-to-24 V transformer. In one configuration, an energy chain system and cable-management package are included, featuring painted steel guide-rails, aluminum guide-troughs, anchoring and mounting assemblies, molded polymer cable carriers, cable separators, strain-relief components, high-voltage shore-power conductors, protective-earth and pilot conductors, 400/480 V auxiliary conductors, fiber-optic and other control/communication cables, and connection interfaces.

title: Gekko Pole-Climbing Shoes
facts: These are pole climbing shoes sold as a pair, one left and one right shoe, designed to attach to a user’s existing footwear for climbing wood or composite poles. The shoes are composed predominantly of aluminum (84 percent) with additional base metals and plastics. Each shoe includes a foot mount featuring a rail with a heel plate and a toe plate, secured by an adjustable plastic strap to fit various footwear sizes. Two sets of spikes are incorporated: one set is attached to the front inner toe for front grip, and the other set is mounted on a bent extruded metal bar extending from the foot mount to grip the pole from the opposite side. The shoes enable users to grip poles from both the front and around the side during climbing.

title: Soft Power Sculpture
facts: The item is a contemporary sculpture created by artist Sabastian Acker. It is formed from a single length of 100% refined copper tubing that has been studied, bent, curved, positioned, and repositioned to achieve an asymmetrical shape with sloping, concave, and convex curves. The sculpture measures approximately 26 cm in height, 65 cm in width, and 11 cm in depth. The artist estimates that around 40 hours were spent from conception through experimentation and creation. The piece was hand-finished after the primary bending process to complete its final form.

title: Isolpack "Alfa 2" Composite Panel
facts: The product is a composite panel measuring 40 mm in total thickness, consisting of two outer facings of galvanized, pre-painted steel sheets each approximately 0.5 mm thick, bonded to a rigid closed-cell polyurethane (PUR/PIR) foam insulating core approximately 39 mm thick. The nominal panel width is approximately 1,000 mm, and it is supplied in lengths of 2,333 mm and 2,032 mm. The approximate weight is 9.07 kg/m², with the steel facings accounting for about 82% by weight and the polyurethane core making up the remainder. The panels are cut and fitted to form the insulated, temperature-controlled body of mobile food and concession trailers, functioning primarily as thermal insulation. The panels are not used as parts of buildings or for building/construction erection.

title: Contemporary Resin Wall Relief Artwork
facts: These are three-dimensional wall-mounted relief artworks produced by the THALZY brand. Each piece is constructed from an epoxy plastic resin that forms sculptural wave-like shapes. The resin relief is manually finished with a glossy epoxy resin coating. Each relief is individually mounted onto an aluminum composite panel and then installed into a wooden frame for display. The artworks vary in design with unique coloring, three-dimensional geometries, proportions, contours, and relief profiles. Sizes range from approximately 10 cm by 10 cm to 30 cm by 30 cm, not including the wooden frame. The pieces are intended for decorative wall mounting in residential or commercial interior spaces.

title: Flail Solidification Mixer
facts: The flail solidification mixer, model FL-243, is a multi-machine system mounted on a steel base skid designed to solidify liquid slurries. It includes a wet feed hooper, wet feed augers and trough, electric motors (360V and 460V), a dry product auger, a rotary mixer with hardened steel flailing chains, a single belt drive with an industrial grade double sided cogged transmission belt, and a control panel. The unit measures 323 inches in length, 163 inches in height, and 76 inches in width, weighing approximately 11,135 lbs. It operates by using a rotating chain-flail mechanism to blend a liquid or semi-fluid feed material with a super absorbent polymer, converting the slurry into a solid, non-flowing mass for transport and landfill disposal. The system processes 86-100 gallons per minute and is intended for use in processing wet mud spoil from hydro-vacuum excavation, particularly for exposing buried utilities, as well as in construction and environmental cleanups.

title: F-16 Simulator Cockpit Shell
facts: The item is a life-sized, stationary metal structure designed to simulate the cockpit of an F-16 fighter jet. It measures approximately 47 square feet in area and stands up to 33 inches high when assembled. The shell is constructed from two metals: steel and aluminum, with steel predominating by weight. It includes a seated pilot station, a metal extension resembling part of the fighter jet’s fuselage, and a metal ladder attached to the side for access. After importation, the shell will be assembled and later fitted with additional furnishings and gaming equipment to enhance realism. The structure serves as a base for users to experience a piloting simulation in an environment that mimics a real aircraft cockpit.

title: KOPPLA Socket
facts: The KOPPLA Socket is a power strip with a plastic housing and a three-meter insulated power cable ending in a NEMA 5-15P plug. It features five standard three-prong AC outlets and two USB-C charging ports, plus an on/off rocker switch. Inside, it contains a printed circuit board assembly, transformers, rectifiers, integrated circuits, and other electronic components. The device operates at a maximum rated voltage of 125 volts. It connects to a standard 125-volt AC wall outlet to supply power to multiple electrical devices, charge compatible electronics directly, and offer protection against electrical overload, short circuits, and overheating.

title: Hydraulic Hose Ferrules and Hose-End Inserts
facts: These items are ferrules and hose-end inserts designed for use in manufacturing flexible hydraulic hose assemblies. The hose-end inserts, also called stems, are specifically dimensioned for insertion into the ends of hydraulic hoses and form the fluid-conducting termination of the completed assembly. After positioning the insert inside the hose-end, a corresponding ferrule is placed over the hose and permanently crimped to mechanically secure the connection. The completed assemblies connect hoses to components such as pumps, cylinders, and valves to transfer high-pressure hydraulic fluid in mobile and industrial machinery. The ferrules and inserts are made from plated carbon steel or stainless steel and are produced in various sizes. The inserts feature various shapes and end connections according to the ISO 12151 series of standards for hydraulic hose fittings. Although imported separately, the ferrules and inserts are engineered to be mutually dependent components of hydraulic hose assemblies.

title: Manual Push Sweeper
facts: These are hand-powered push sweepers designed for use on lawns, patios, and driveways. Each unit features two wheels, each 10 inches in diameter, connected to a main housing that contains two horizontal rotating roller brushes. When the sweeper is pushed forward, the wheels drive the brushes to rotate, collecting fallen leaves, grass clippings, dead branches, gravel, and other debris into a removable hopper bag. The brushes have an adjustable height. Model S19-002A has a hopper capacity of 7 cubic feet and a cleaning width of 26 inches. Model S-19-003A has a hopper capacity of 12 cubic feet and a cleaning width of 30 inches.

title: Autonomous Driving Module
facts: The product is an Integrated Performance Computer Unit (IPCU) designed for installation inside motor vehicles to enable autonomous driving capabilities. It consists of two printed circuit board assemblies. The first board contains a main processing unit, memory, and components dedicated to executing autonomous driving and parking functions. The second board serves as an interface unit that connects and communicates with vehicle systems including cameras, radar units, radio equipment, phone systems, and other onboard apparatus. Once installed, the IPCU operates as a centralized computing platform that gathers data from multiple vehicle sensors and sources. This collected data is processed using artificial intelligence algorithms, which enable the vehicle to navigate and operate without driver input.

title: High Density Polyethylene Jugs with Polypropylene Caps
facts: These are empty jugs made from high density polyethylene (HDPE) with a capacity of 2.5 gallons. Each jug measures approximately 14.35 inches in height and features a top opening measuring 2.50 inches in diameter. The jugs are imported complete with screw caps and dispensing closures made from polypropylene (PP). They are designed for single use and will be filled with liquid carwash chemicals such as detergents, presoaks, protectants, waxes, and tire dressings after importation. The finished containers are marketed and sold specifically for use in the professional carwash industry.

title: Half Disco Ball with Metal Spring and Plastic Base
facts: The item is a half disco ball measuring approximately 3 inches by 3 inches by 3 inches. The surface of the disco ball consists of small square glass mirror tiles that are glued to a plastic half sphere. A metal spring is attached to the disco ball and connects it to a molded plastic base. The entire assembly weighs approximately $1.00 in value. The product is composed of glass mirror tiles, a plastic half sphere, a metal spring, and a plastic base. It functions as a decorative lighting accessory when placed in a room or venue.
